tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sa skya'i gnas bshad rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar snyan brgyud dang bcas pa phun tshogs rgya mtsho'i gter zhes bya ba grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i gsung rtsom gnang 'phro 'thor bur bzhugs pa rnams sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyi bla ma'i thugs kyi rnam thar rnams dran pa'i rkyen gyis dad pa'i dbang gi phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa bzhugs/ 'di'i tshig ring rigs phal cher phal skad lta bur mdzad pa ni kun gyi go sla ba la dgongs par snang bas dregs ldan nga rgyal can rnams kyis log lta ma byed gcig/ ༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ sid+dhi shwa ra badz+ra tsar+ya s+ya ban+da nam kā ro maṃ/ bod skad du/ grub pa'i dbang phyug rdo rje slob dpon la gus pas phyag bgyi'o/ /zhes mchod par brjod nas/ dpal ldan sa skya'i gnas bshad rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar snyan brgyud dang bcas pa phun tshogs rgya mtsho'i gter zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i gsung rtsom 'phro can 'thor bur bzhugs pa rnams phyogs cig tu bsgrigs pa ni 'di lta ste/ oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ na mo mañju gho ṣa ā nan+da rat+na ya/ 'dir gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i chos grwa yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas kyi gnas bshad rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar snyan brgyud dang bcas pa phun tshogs rgya mtsho'i gter chen zhes bya ba/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang dbyer med pa'i khams gsum 'gro ba'i mgon po/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo/ srid pa gsum gyi 'dren mchog dam par gyur pa/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyin mo ltar ches cher gsal bar mdzad cing / mthong thos dran reg tsam gyi bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi mchog stsol bar mdzad pa'i bdag nyid nges pa'i don du drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po dang dbyer ma mchis pa dmigs pa med pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje'i mnga' bdag bka' drin can gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mo dri ma med pa la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/

/brtse ba chen pos dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du rjes su bzung du gsal lo/ /stobs dang mi 'jigs so so'i rig 'od can/ /shes bya'i mkha' la chags thogs med 'gro zhing / /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i ma rig mun sel ba/ /thub dbang nyi ma'i mchog der gus pas 'dud/ /'bad rtsol rnam spangs rang bzhin brjod bral yang / /chos dbyings zab don rtogs pa'i sgra dbyangs ni/ /nges don rtogs pa'i dbus na cher sgrog pa'i/ /'jam dbyangs dam chos rnga chen rgyal gyur cig /mngon nas gyur pa'i dpal la mnga' brnyes shing / /bdag med zhal gyi bdud rtsi thob pa na/ /'jig rten dregs pa'i 'khengs pa 'phrogs so zhes/ /bir+wa mthu chen sgrog la snying nas 'dud/ /rgyal ba kun gyi spyi gzugs chen mo mchog /phun tshogs bslu med dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso/ /bar chad bdud dpung mtha' dag tshar gcod pa'i/ /rdzu 'phrul thogs med pad 'byung chen por 'dud/ /kun mkhyen dga' mdzad ngang tshul des pa can/ /byang chub snying po mchog tu brnyes pa skyes/ /khyed kyi mkhyen brtse'i nus pa 'di 'dra ba/ /shes bya'i khyon 'dir gshong ba ngo mtshar 'dud/ /gang sku bsod nams bye ba las grub 'di/ /rab mdzes brgya byin gyis kyang rtogs min la/ /yon tan sa bcu'i rtse mo la gnas pa'i/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi bgrang 'das de la 'dud/ /zung dang ting 'dzin mngon shes grags pa dang / /rgyal ba'i mtshan dpes mchog tu rab mdzes shing / /mi 'jigs so so yang dag rig pa 'di/ /mchod 'os blo gros chen por ji bzhin 'dud/ /kun dga' yon tan tshad med rnam par rgyas/ /rtogs pa'i rgyal mtshan gong nas gong du 'phel/ /gsung rab dpal 'byor bzang po'i gter rnams phye/ /legs bshad 'od kyis 'jig rten gsal la 'dud/ /nye dbang dbus na brjid pa'i lha dbang ni/ /dam chos 'od kyi blo gros rab 'byed cing / /bslab gsum ngur smrig rgyal mtshan legs 'dzin pa'i/

/'gro ba'i bla ma mtshungs bral de la 'dud/ /khyad par gsang sngags zab don bdud rtsi'i dpal/ /thos pa tsam gyis 'gro kun dga' bskyed cing / /thar pa'i go 'phang rin chen ster mdzad pa/ /skye dgu'i skyabs mgon sngags 'chang chen por 'dud/ /de ltar 'gro ba'i skyabs gnas mchog gyur pa/ /yongs 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal zhing / /rgyun chad med par gdung ba'i gsol btab nas/ /dpal ldan stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams ltar/ /rgyal ba'i tshogs bcas nges pa lnga ldan zhing / /gsang chen smra ba kun gyi bsti gnas mchog /mkhas mang 'du ba'i gdan sa bsngags par bgyis/ /de yang spyir gyi sa zhes bya ba yis/ /sgra yi don la go bo zhes pa 'byung / /de las drangs na don tshan dgu yin te/ /ngag phyogs pa dang 'od zer ba glang mig /rdo rje mtho ris chu gter zhes bya ste/ /don tshan de rnams rkang pa re re dang / /sbyar zhing sdeb sbyor gzhung bzhin brjod pa na/ /mkhas pa'i dbang po shākya mchog ldan gyis/ /ngag gi dbang po'i dge mtshan brgya phrag zhig /phyogs brgyar 'phros pa'i dpal yon 'dus pa las/ /sa skyong dbang po stong gis gus btud pa'i/ /'od zer brgya phrag 'khrigs pa'i gur khang du/ /ba mchog 'dod 'jo yid bzhin nor bu dang / /glang chen dkar pos btegs pa'i khri steng der/ /mig gnyis 'dzum pa'i gar bsgyur 'jam pa'i dpal/ /rdo rje rnon po bzhad pa'i gad rgyang can/ /mtho ris dbang po'i lus la mdzes zhugs nas/ /chu bo'i gter bzhin thub bstan rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /legs par gnas pas sa 'dzin dkar po'i khyon/ /sa skya zhes grags snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs ni/ /stong gsum khor yug ri bo'i khong las brgal/ /de skad gsungs phyir ngo mtshar gnas mchog yin/ /de yang rab dkar gangs ri'i phreng ba yis/ /kun nas bskor zhing brgyud de gnas pa'i dbus/

/rab brjid lhun po'i ded dpon chen po ste/ /rang bzhin lhun grub ri bo'i dbang po mchog /'di ni ri dwags dbus na ri dwags kyi/ /rgyal po dregs pa 'gying zhing gnas pa ltar/ /khams gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i gdan sa 'di/ /sham+bha la ltar khyad par 'phags par mngon/ /de nang rin chen sna tshogs ltar ba la/ /dpal stug dpal gyi rgyal po chen po rnams/ /zab yangs rgya chen chos 'khor bskor ba'i gzhi/ /mchog gi sa skyobs rab brjid gdong lnga pa/ /'og min zhing du 'gro snyam bgyid pa 'di/ /mdog dkar gangs ri'i logs dang mtshungs pa ste/ /thog ma'i rgyal bas chos 'khor bskor ba'i gnas/ /shar ri'i dbang po bra chung gong kha ni/ /sa 'dzin dbang po bsrubs shing rab bskyod nas/ /lha min dbang po'i chu gter bsrubs pa las/ /legs 'ong legs ldan dbang po 'gying pa bzhin/ /mdog bzang dbang sngon brkyangs pa'i spu kha can/ /'gyogs 'gro du ma'i tshogs dang lhan cig tu/ /cang shes dbang po zas la spyod 'dra ni/ /kha 'u'i dal 'bab rin chen 'byung gnas lags/ /chu khur 'khrigs pas dga' mgu'i rma bya zhig /mig mdzes mjug sgro dkar te zlos gar pa/ /rdzing bu'i khyon mang mthon por tshom 'dra 'di/ /kha dog yid 'ong dbang sngon ri bo lags/ /chos grwa chen po'i byang ri dpon po ri/ /bya phran bye ba'i dbus na rab brjid pa'i/ /mkha' lding ma rgad 'dab mas mdzes pa zhig /ngo mtshar ngang tshul bzang po gnas la drangs/ /ma rgad 'khrigs 'dra'i phra yi rab mdzes pa'i/ /rin chen 'dzin ma'i khyon gyi 'khor lo 'di/ /zab yangs chos 'khor bskor du gsol cig ces/ /'jig rten byed pos 'dud cing phul ba'am/ /sa la dbang bsgyur skya sengs las lhag pa'i/ /gling bzhi'i bdag po mchog tu gyur pa yis/ mtho ris bdag pos 'khor lo la sogs pa/ /rin chen bdun gyi thog ma bkur la drangs/ /gzhan yang rgyab ri glang chen 'gying 'dra yis/

/lto ba'i sa dkar btsun mo bu 'khur 'dra/ /dpon po ri ni blon po 'gying pa 'dra/ /kha 'u gtsang po rta mchog rin chen 'dra/ /brag dmar shar ri dmag dpon khros pa 'dra/ /jo mo phur ri nor bu rin chen 'dra/ /de sogs dge mtshan bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /rags pa tsam zhig 'dir ni brjod pa yin/ /zhib tu kho bos brjod pa ga la nus/ /'on kyang cung zad brjod pa 'di dag kyang / /rang bzo ma yin yid ches khung thub bdog /de yi rgyu mtshan 'di ltar yin no dgongs/ /de lta'i gnas chen de rnams thams cad kyang / /rgyal ba rigs lnga rdo rje 'chang la sogs/ /so sos byin gyis rlabs pa'i gnas yin te/ /de yang rje btsun chen po'i gsung mgur du/ /bka' tshig rdo rje'i rang bzhin 'di ltar 'byung / /nga bsdod sa'i dpal ldan sa skya 'di/ /gnas 'og min gyi gnas dang mthun par 'dug /shar bra chung gong kha glang po'i sna/ /zung 'jug gi 'gro ba 'dren pa po/ /rje mi bskyod rdo rje'i bzhugs gnas yin/ /lho kha 'u gtsang po rin chen rta/ /'gro ba'i bsam pa 'gengs ba can/ /rin chen 'byung ldan gyi bzhugs gnas yin/ /nub chu mig ne'u gseng rma bya'i mdongs/ /'gro ba chos la 'dren pa po/ /rje 'od dpag med kyi bzhugs gnas yin/ /sa dkar po seng ge'i mgo bo 'dra/ /dpal ldan sa skya seng ge'i lus/ /'gro drug gi bsam pa 'gengs pa po/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang gi bzhugs gnas yin/ /de 'dra'i 'og min gyi gnas mchog na/ /nga rdo rje 'chang gi rnal 'byor bde/ /spros pa chod pa'i rnal 'byor bde/ /rigs sngags kyi go cha sra bas bde/ /man ngag gi mdzod dang ldan pas bde/ /lta ba'i gdengs dang ldan pas bde/ /dam tshig gi ra bas chod pas bde/ /bdag gcig pu'i kha po ma lags te/ /'di bzhin kun la bdog pa lags/ /de skad gsung pa de rnams thugs la bzhogs/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang 'di la khyad par med/

/'khrul med yin no dgongs gzhis mdzad 'tshal lo/ /de 'dra'i bsti gnas khyad par 'phags pa ste/ /srid zhi'i phun tshogs rgya cher 'byung ba 'di/ /'jam dbyangs 'jam dpal 'jam pa'i rdo rje ni/ /rim bdun rim bzhin rim par byon nas kyang / /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab rgyal ba ji bzhin du/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mdzad/ /'gro don 'gro rnams 'gro ba'i gnas nyid las/ /thar 'dod thar pa thar las bstan pa'i gnas/ /bde chen bde legs bde ba ster zhes gsungs/ /ma rig las 'khon rig pa'i blo gros can/ /dkon mchog gsum dang sa skyong rgyal po yis/ /dge legs kun dge legs kun ster ba des/ /bag yod ldan pa mkha' la shar ba'i tshe/ /gdan sa'i mchog ste gdan sa'i mchog gyur pa/ mig pa'i grong khyer grong khyer ser skya ltar/ /lha mi'i phun tshogs phun tshogs 'byung gnas 'di/ /bkra shis dge mtshan du mar bcas te bsgrub/ /rgyal ba'i rnam sprul rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi /byin rlabs gnas 'di sa'i thig ler gyur/ /'dzam bu gling gi 'dzin ma'i khyon gyi dbus/ /dbus kyi lte ba rdo rje'i rang bzhin zhing / /zhing khams rgya mtsho ma lus kun gyi mchog /mchog 'di sa yi snying po yin pa te/ /skye dgu kun la rab dga'i dpal ster ba/ /gang gi byang chub snying po brnyes pa'i gzhi/ /rdo rje'i rang bzhin rdo rje gdan 'di ni/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i byang chub brnyes pa'i gnas/ /ma ga ta yang 'di las gzhan du ci/ /rin chen sna tshogs 'khrig pa'i rang bzhin can/ /phyi rol lcags ri'i khor yug dpag yas la/ /dpal 'byor 'du ba'i sgo mang ldan pa 'di/ /blta na sdug dang mtshungs kyi gzhan dang min/ /der phyir rdo rje'i rang bzhin mu 'khyud 'di/ /ma rung 'byung po'i gdon tshogs thams cad bcom/ /lus can kun gyi gnod tshogs rab tu bkag /skyes chen bsod nams ldan pa'i bsten byar gyur/

/longs spyod rnam mang ldan pa'i gnas mang yang / /rig pa'i 'byung gnas 'di las gzhan yod min/ /yid 'phrog mdzes pa'i rang bzhin mang yod kyang / /dgos 'dod bsgrub pa bsal 'phel gcig po tsam/ /rtsi bcud du mar ldan pa'i sman ljongs rnams/ /'gro kun bde 'gro kun bde'i gnas bzang ltar/ /bkra shis rtags mtshan brgyad kyi spras pa la/ /dmar ser 'od kyi rgya chen 'dzin ma'i khyon/ /rnam par gsal byed mdzes pa'i me tog rnams/ /dri zhim dri ngad phyogs bcur 'phro ba'i rtser/ /sbrang rtsi'i dregs pa bung ba gzhon nu'i tshogs/ /dga' ba'i dar dir bsgrogs shing gnas pa ni/ /'jam dbyangs mchod phyir lha yi sprul pa snyam/ /de phyir rgyal dang rgyal sras kyi brten zhing / /rig gnas phul byung rnams kyi bsti gnas sa/ ngur smrig 'dzin pa rnams kyi dga' tshal ste/ /gdan sa mchog 'di byang chub snying po yin/ /spyir gyi gdan sa chen po 'di nyid la/ /dpal ldan sa skya zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ /lugs gnyis dpal gyi 'byor pa dang ldan zhing / /sgrib gnyis ma gos sa sogs dkar zhing skya/ /de phyir dpal ldan sa skya zhes su grags/ /de yang 'khrul pa'i dri ma ma lus pa/ /zad par spangs pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi/ /rje btsun rtse mo'i sku bstod khyod nyid mar/ /bkra shis dge mtshan dpal gyi mngon mtho ba/ /sa yi mchog gyur sa sogs dkar mdangs skya/ /cho 'brangs mchog gyur ma rig las 'khon ste/ /spang bya'i g.yul las rgyal zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ /de ltar dpal ldan sa skya'i gnas chen 'di/ /thog mar 'byung ba'i lung bstan mdzad tshul ni/ /jo bo chen po dpal ldan a ti shas/ /bod la 'byon skabs chu 'dus phyogs kyi lam/ /rim par brgyud de la rtser byon pa'i tshe/ /legs par gzigs pas dpon po ri kha 'di/ /dkar la snum pa ngo mtshar che ba'i ngos/ /'brong rgod chen po gnyis ni ngur sgra 'don/

/spu sprugs byed cing skyid nyams sna tshogs ston/ /rtswa bza' chu 'thung byed pa gzigs ma thag /de skad gsungs pas da lta'i bar du yang / /la de'i ming la 'brong ngur la zhes pa/ /skye bo kun la yongs su grags pa yin/ /de nas g.ya' lung nang gi lam brgyud de/ /rim gyis phebs pas sa skya'i 'dabs su byon/ /da lta phyag 'tshal yod pas 'di nyid du/ /chibs las gzhol te slob 'khor thams cad la/ /da ni 'di ru phyag mchod rgyas pa zhig /byed dgos 'dug pas de yi grabs kyis gsungs/ /de tshe slob 'khor rnams kyi ci yin snyam/ /the tshom skyes te jo bo nyid la zhus/ /jo bo chen po'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ /dpon po ri yi nub kyi ri 'debs la/ /hrī:yig gcig dang dhiḥyig bdun dang ni/ /hūm̐ yig gcig rnams 'dug pas byas pa yin/ /de rnams yongs ba'i rgyu mtshan 'di ltar yin/ /bod yul gangs can ljongs kyi bsod nams la/ /gnas chen 'di ru spyan ras gzigs dbang mchog /khar+sa pa ṇi'i sprul pa dngos su 'byon/ /de yi sras dang yang sras la sogs la/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul pa bdun tsam gyi/ /bar du rgyun chad med pa 'byung ba yin/ /der rjes phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa ni/ /nus mthur ldan pa gcig rnams yong ba'i rtags/ /der yang ma zad la rtser gleng ba yis/ /'brong rgod gnyis kyang chos skyong che chung ste/ /gur zhal rnam gnyis 'byon par 'gyur ba yin/ /bla ma chos skyong ngo mtshar can dag ni/ /rim par 'byon zhing gnas mchog 'di nyid du/ sangs rgyas bstan pa nyin mor byed pa'i mchog /'gro ba kun gyi gtsug gi nor bu 'byung / /de yi phyir na rang re dpon slob rnams/ /phyag mchod rgyas par 'bul ba bsod nams che/ /de skad gsungs nas phyag mchod rgyas pa mdzad/ /de yi sa la da lta'i bar du yang / /phyag 'tshal sgang zhes skye 'gro yongs la grags/ /der yang ma zad grub thob kun gyi gtso/

/slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi'ang / /gnas mchog 'di ru rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan pa rin chen rgyun chad med par 'byung / /'di nyid mi 'gyur ba yi rten 'brel la/ /phyogs bzhir mchod rten chen po bzhi gnang nas/ /dgon gnas phun tshogs 'byung ba byin gyis brlabs/ /'di bzhi'i ming la da lta'i bar du yang / /sa skya mi 'gyur ba yis gzer bzhi zer/ /de ni gnas dang gang zag gnyis ka yi/ /lung bstan yin cing rgyas bshad 'og tu 'byung / /'on kyang thog mar gang zag byon tshul gyis/ /'phros don cung zad tsam cig brjod pa na/ /lha 'khon sa skya'i gdung rabs rnams gsum las/ /dang po lha rab bcu gsum byon tshul ni/ /spyir gyi lha la rnam grangs mang yod kyang / /'di ni 'od gsal lha nyid yin pas na/ /ngo bo 'od lha rnam pa mir sprul ste/ /shel tshwa rgyal mo gangs kyi rtsa bar babs/ de yang spyi ring g.yu ring g.yu se gsum/ /rim bzhin byon nas g.yu se'i mi rje mdzad/ /de yi grogs su gcen po g.yu ring byon/ /g.yu ring dang ni dmu gza' ldem bu'i sras/ /ma bzang spun bdun byon pa'i gcen po drug /yab dang bcas pa lha yi yul du gshegs/ /bdun gyi tha chung ma bzang spyi rje dang / /thog lcam 'ur mo'i sras ni dpa' bo stag /de dang klu lcam dra ma gnyis kyi sras/ /klu tsha stag po 'od can zhes bya byung / /klu tsha dang ni mon gza' mtsho rgyal sras/ /g.ya' spang 'tshams su 'khrungs pas mtshan mchog kyang / /de ltar grags shing dpa' bo chen po byon/ /de dag lha yi gdung rabs bcu gsum yin/ /gnyis pa 'khon gyi gdung rabs byung tshul ni/ /skyes chen mthu rtsal ldan pa de nyid kyis/ /srin po bsad nas chung ma khab du bzhes/ /sras gcig byung pa 'khon bar skyes zhes grags/ /de dang btsan gza' lcam bu sgron gyi sras/ /gzugs mdzes blo ldan mi yul dkon pa 'khrungs/

/de la dkon pa rje gung stag ces btags/ /de yi rgyal po'i nang blon mdzad pa'i tshe/ /'khon ston dpal po che zhes kun la grags/ /skyes mchog de dang glang za ne chung sras/ /klu dbang la sogs sku mched lnga yin te/ /bzhi ni yum gcig rdo rje rin chen ni/ /yum kha mi cig de yi rgyu mtshan ni/ /rje btsun chen po'i gsung las 'byung ba ste/ /de yi gcung zhig gsung pa 'di nyid kyi/ /sku mched bzhi yi gcung po yin pa bstan/ /phal pa zhes pa'i tshig gi nus pa yi/ /yum nyid phal pa yin te mi gcig par/ /legs par bstan zhing sras kyi che ba ni/ /yon tan kun gyi phyug ces gsungs pa yin/ /der yang ma zad dpal ldan bla ma yis/ /rigs 'dzin bskul du tshig bcad mdzad par yang / /gcung ston rdo rje rin chen zhes pa dang / /sngags 'chang rgya dkar shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi'ang / /rdo rje rin chen klu yi gcung po yin/ /zhes sogs bsgrub byed bkod rgyu mang yod kyang / /yi ge mang dogs re zhig then par bya/ /rdor rin btsun mo 'bro gza' g.yang lon skyid/ /de gnyis sras bdun gcen drug so sor byon/ /chung ba shes rab yon tan tshul khrims rgyal/ /gtsug tor shes rab dge skyabs dge mthong ngo / /'khon ston bal po shākya blo gros rnams/ /rim bzhin snga ma'i rigs sras phyi ma yin/ /shākya blo gros sras gnyis che ba'i mtshan/ /'khon rog shes rab tshul khrims zhes bya dang / /dkon mchog rgyal po sku mched rnam gnyis ste/ /de rnams 'khon gyi brgyud pa byung tshul lags/ /de nas gsum pa 'dren mchog sa skya pa'i/ /gdung rabs byung tshul brjod na 'di ltar yin/ /dkon mchog rgyal po sku mched rnam gnyis kyis/ /thog mar g.ya' lung 'jag gshong la sogs su/ /rgyun ring bzhugs rjes bra bo lung zhes par/ /bzhugs pa'i bar skabs zhig tu de nyid kyi/ /nub kyi ri der skyo sangs mdzad phyir byon/

/de nas byang gi phyogs la gzigs pa na/ /dge mtshan du ma ldan pa'i ri bo mchog /dpon po ri 'di gzigs pa tsam gyi mod/ /de ma thag tu dge mtshan 'di ltar gzigs/ /ri bo dkar po snum cing gzi 'od 'bar/ /de yi dbyibs ni 'di ltar yod pa yin/ /glang chen nyal 'dra'i lte ba'i thad kyi ri/ /btsun mo pang du bu 'khur 'dra ba dang / /chu bo dar dkar brkyangs 'dra g.yas su 'bab/ /de la sogs pa khyad par 'phags pa yi/ /bkra shis dge mtshan phun sum tshogs pa gzigs/ /'di yi rgyas bshad 'og tu rim gyis 'byung / /gra bo lung pa zer ba 'di nyid kyang / /ding sang rang bzo sna tshogs 'chad gyur kyang / /don gyi gra bo lung ni 'di ltar yin/ /gdan sa chen po 'di yi lho ngos la/ /lung pa gnyis kyi nub ma 'di nyid ste/ /da lta dpal chen pho brang yod pa'i lho/ /phal pa'i ming 'dogs sa skya gog po zer/ /sngon gyi dus na gra lung dgon par grags/ /'di la 'khrul pa med do nges shes mdzod/ /gong gi dge mtshan de dag gzigs pa'i tshe/ /sa yi bdag po zhang gzhung gu ra ba/ /lha mi grong bdun la sogs thams cad la/ /bla ma dkon mchog rgyal pos 'di skad gsungs/ /dpon po ri 'dir nged kyi dgon chung cig /'debs par 'dod pas rin cig bcal ba na/ /khyed rnams kun gyis blo grol e yong na/ /gsungs ma thag tu de dag thams cad kyis/ /bka' gros mthun par cis kyang gnang ba zhu/ /rin gyi rnam pa cig kyang mi zhu zhes/ /yang yang zhus kyang phyi rab tshun dgongs nas/ /rin chen phreng ba rgon ma mo gos sogs/ /legs par gnang rjes stod kyi mon grog nas/ /smad kyi 'bal grog yan gyi sa gzhi rnams/ /'khon ston dkon mchog rgyal po nyid la phul/ /grog po gnyis kyang sgra bshad 'di ltar yin/ /'bal grog zhes pa sha za mkha' 'gro rnams/ /grog por 'tshogs nas dam nyams bza' bar byed/ /de phyir mkha' 'gro grog po byas kyang chog

/mon grog zhes pa mon chung pu tra rnams/ /'dug pa'i grog po yin pas de skad zer/ /'di yi lo rgyus zhib par 'og tu 'byung / /de nas 'khon ston dkon mchog rgyal po yis/ /sgo rum gzim spyil dkar po 'di nyid ni/ /chu mo glang gi lo la 'debs par mdzad/ /de nas brtse chen kun dga' snying po yis/ /'jam dpal brag khung la sogs ji snyed dang / /mi thub zla ba bsod nams rtse mo yis/ /gzim khang rnying ma la sogs ji snyed dang / /khyad par rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis/ /dbu rtse rnying ma la sogs ji snyed dang / /gnas lnga rig pa sa skya paṇa chen gyis/ /sgo rum se khang la sogs ji snyed dang / /'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa yis/ /rin chen sgang gi gtsug lag khang la sogs/ /ji snyed bgrang las 'das par bzhengs par mdzad/ /de yang thog mar sgo rum 'debs pa'i tshe/ /sa chog mdzad dus gzhi bdag so so la/ /bka' bsgo dam bzhag mdzad cing khyad par du/ /klu rgyal gtsug na rin chen zhes bya la/ /khyed kyi sa 'dir nged kyi dgon gnas cig /legs par 'debs dgos 'dug pas thang cig la/ /khyed rnams 'dug sa gzhan zhig 'tshol gsungs pas/ /klu rgyal nyid kyi zhu lan 'di skad phul/ /nged kyi nor rdzas bskyed par brtsams na yang / /mi lo lnga brgya'i bar du ga la 'khyos/ /bla ma'i dgon pa'ang mi lo lnga brgya las/ /e gnas mi shes de phyir bdag cag gi /gnas bdag byas nas bla ma khyed rang gi /bar chad med cing mthun rkyen bsgrub pa sogs/ /bka' lung gang gnang 'phrin las bsgrub chog pa/ /'di nyid thugs rjes bzung nas gnang ba zhu/ /de skad zhus pas bla ma shin tu mnyes/ /der rjes gzim spyil dkar pos thog drangs pa'i/ /gtsug lag khang rnams rim gyis 'debs par mdzad/ /klu rgyal gtsug na rin chen zhes bya ba'ang / /bla ma gong mas mtshan gsol ma gtogs pa/ /dngos ming brjod na klu chen brgyad kyi nang /

/klu rgyal sog ma med ces bya ba yin/ /'di la sog ma med ces zer ba yi/ /rgyu mtshan yod de sngon gyi dus su ni/ /'phags yul ma ga ta yi yul ljongs na/ /bram ze mes sbyin zer ba'i sngags pa gcig /yon tan che zhing khyad par ser bsrung la/ /'khor lo bcug pa tsam gyi ser ba nyid/ /mi 'byung nges pa kun gyi mthun snang grub/ /'on kyang le lo chen po yod pa yis/ /yang yang lag len byed pa dka' las ched/ /snyam du lo gsum ser ba mi 'byung ba'i/ /rten 'brel rdzas sogs thams cad byas pa na/ /der yod skye bo 'ga' yi lab lugs la/ /rang re rnams kyi bsod nams dpal las byung / /de las gzhan pa bram zes byas pa min/ /zer ba thos pas bram ze rab khros te/ /smon lam 'debs pa gang rang mthu myur ces/ /kun la dris pas dge 'dun myur ro zer/ /de tshe bram ze mes sbyin de nyid kyi/ /dge slong bzhi sde cig la brnyed bkur ni/ /phun sum tshogs pa byas rjes ngan pa yis/ /smon lam 'di ltar 'debs par byas pa yin/ /bdag cag skye ba 'di nas shi 'phos nas/ /ma ga ta yi yul phyogs 'di nyid kyi/ /lo thog thams cad bcom ste lhag ma yi/ /sog ma tsam yang med par byed nus pa'i/ /klu rgyal nus pa can du skye bar shog /de skad smon lam btab pa'i 'bras bu yis/ /ji ltar smon pa bzhin du 'grub par gyur/ /de nas ma ga ta yi yul ljongs der/ /ser ba phab te sog ma tsam gcig kyang / /med par byas pas klu rgyal 'di nyid la/ /sog ma med ces yongs su grags pa yin/ /'di ni sngon gyi legs bshad dag las mthong / /khung thub yin no long ba 'khar 'dzugs min/ /klu yi rgyal po gtsug na rin chen 'di'i/ /lto ba sgo srung nang gi shar phyogs kyi/ /klu khang sman se yod sa 'di nyid yin/ /mjug ma sag sa'i rdzing bu yod sa yin/ /spyi gtsug bskor lam chen mo'i 'og 'khris te/ /bde chen gling gi lcags ri'i shar stod na/

/sman se'i sdong po yod sa de nyid yin/ /'di la nged rang byis pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /se sdong de yi dkyil na gos chen gyi/ /kha dog sna tshogs bsgrigs pa'i rgyal mtshan la/ /gser thog ngo mtshar can gcig yod pa mthong / /lan gcig ma yin yang yang mthong ba byung / /klu rgyal chen po'i gnas lugs de ltar yin/ /de nas rim gyis dar rgyas byung ba ste/ /de yang thog mar brtse ba chen po nyid/ /byon tshul mdo tsam brjod na 'di ltar yin/ /jo bo chen pos hrīḥyig gzigs pa de/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam 'phrul nyid/ /legs par 'byung zhing spyan ras gzigs dbang la/ /rnam grangs shin tu mang ba yod gyur zhing / /der yang ma zad spyi yi sangs rgyas la'ang / /stong dang rtsa gcig la sogs mang po yod/ /don la sangs rgyas thams cad dbyer med yin/ /'on kyang 'dul bya gang gis 'dul ba la/ /de dang de yi snang ngor rang rang gi /sku yi bkod pa re re nges par dgos/ /dper na gdul bya zhi bas 'dul ba la/ /khro bor bstan pas mi 'thus de bzhin du/ /drag pos 'dul la zhi bas ci zhig bya/ /des na spyan ras gzigs kyang gang yin gyi/ /sku ru sprul pas mi 'thus nges pa can/ /'dir ni khar+sa pa ṇi yin par nges/ /de yi rgyu mtshan 'og tu rim pas 'byung / /de la thog mar dkon mchog rgyal po yis/ /zhang gzhung gu ra ba yi bu sring ma/ /rdo rje phyug mo zhes bya mkha' 'gro ma/ /de nyid khab tu bzhes par gyur na'ang / /rigs sras gcig kyang 'byon par ma gyur mod/ /de nas re zhig song ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /bla chen dgung lo nga dgu bzhes pa'i dus/ /ma gcig dkar gong lung ma zhes bya la/ /'gro ba kun gyi gtsug rgyan sras gcig 'khrungs/ /yum gyi mtshan la mkhar sgong lung ma zhes/ /deng sang phal cher gleng bar byed na yang / /'di ni mkhar sgong ma yin dkar gong yin/ /de yi rgyu mtshan lung pa 'di nyid na/

/gser kha yod pas de yi kha bun la/ /dkar gong 'byung pas de yi lung par grags/ /da lta sgra don nor ba 'ba' zhig 'chad/ /des na dkar gong lung ma dag rgyu yin/ /'di la the tshom dgos rgyu mi 'dug na'ang / /dkar gong lung pa'i bu sring yin pa snyam/ /byed pa'i blo chung 'ga' zhig yod na yang / /de 'dra ma yin zhang gzhung gu ra ba'i/ /bu mo yin te rdo rje phyug mo dang / /yab gcig yum gcig sku mched yin pa las/ /'di nyid dkar gong lung du bag la byon/ /khyo rnams 'das rjes khong rang bzhugs pa las/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po kha 'u pa/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya'i 'od gsal la/ /dkar gong lung gi mdun gyi nam mkha'i thad/ /'ja' 'od gur khang 'khyil pa'i dbus nyid na/ /ngo bo bar srid rnam pa spyan ras gzigs/ /khar+sa pa ṇi zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /g.yas pa mchog sbyin g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis/ /ut+pal dkar po 'dzin pa'i rnam pa la/ /dar dang rin chen du mas rab brgyan te/ /zhabs gnyis mnyam bzhengs bzhugs pa dngos lta bu/ /gzigs pa de nyid legs par brtags pa na/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang rnam sprul 'byon par dgongs/ /de nas rje btsun kha 'u pa de yis/ /rten 'brel 'grig par dgongs te sa skya ru/ /'khon ston dkon mchog rgyal po de nyid la/ /'di khar byon dang gsung gleng phran bu gda'/ /de skad gsungs nas yang dang yang du byon/ /phal cher nyin 'khor mdzad pa sha stag las/ /thang cig nyi ma ma rgas tsam du bsgor/ /de nas phud rin nas zhig gnang nas brdzangs/ /do nub 'di yi phud tshod gcig nyos las/ /dkar gong lung du nges par zhugs shig gsungs/ /dkon mchog rgyal po'i thugs la 'di ltar 'khrungs/ /de ring nyi ma 'di 'dra'i phyi ba la/ /bsdod kyang mi gsung snyam nas thugs yid chad/ /phru ma'i 'og gi ri gdong de nyid nas/ /skyed lhas phyogs la phyir mig gzigs nas ni/ /rgan po brdzangs nas bla ma thugs rje chung /

/de skad gsungs pas thugs rje gdong kyang zer/ /thugs yid chad pas yid chad 'phrang yang zer/ /de nas yin yang bla ma ci gsungs byed/ /snyam du rim gyis dal bus byon pa na/ /dkar gong lung du nyi ma ma rgas bar/ /legs par phebs shing dkar gong lung ma nyid/ /chu zhig bcus nas g.yas bskor yong pa gnyis/ /ma bsgrigs rang 'grig rten 'brel de ru 'grigs/ /de nas gnas tshang dgos zhes bka' stsal pas/ /shin tu gus pas nang du gdan drangs nas/ /brnyed bkur phun sum tshogs par 'bul ba byas/ /de nas bla mas chang cig 'tshong gsungs pas/ /phud tshod shin tu che zhing ro mchog ldan/ /snod kyang gas chag la sogs skyon bral zhig /legs par phul nas 'di la rin mi 'tshal/ /zhus kyang bla mas gnang ba'i nas de gnang / /de nas do nub bla ma'i bka' bzhin du/ /bzhugs par mdzad de rten 'brel thams cad 'grigs/ /der rjes rim gyis zla grangs tshang ba na/ /rje btsun kha 'u pa yi bka' lung la/ /de ni 'di phyogs gdan drangs nga rang gis/ /bkur bsti rim 'gro gang drag byed pa yin/ /gsungs nas gnas mchog khru mar legs phebs te/ /khru ma sgrub gnas zhes pa'i sgra bshad ni/ /brtse ba chen po kun dga' snying po yis/ /sku yi khru ma bzhugs pas de skad zer/ /de yang cung zad rnam par phye ba na/ /'di ni brtse chen kun dga' snying po yi/ /'khrungs sa yin te de yi rgyu mtshan ni/ /de dus kha 'ub skyed lhas 'di nyid la/ /nag khrims shin tu dam pa yod pas na/ /ma gcig zhang mo 'di ru bzhugs dgos byung / /de nas re zhig song ba'i skabs zhig tu/ /chu pho spre 'u lo yi dus bzang tshe/ /ngo mtshar ltas mchog du ma dang bcas te/ /sku bltams rje btsun chen po kha 'ub pas/ /bsngags pa ches cher mdzad cing sku pang bzhes/ /'di ni nges par spyan ras gzigs yin cing / /byang sems sbyin pa dpal yang 'di nyid yin/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug rje btsun bir+wa pa'ang /

/'di nyid kho na yin pa'i nges shes yod/ /gsungs nas shin tu dges pa'i rnam 'gyur mdzad/ /de nas brtse ba chen po 'di 'khrungs pas/ /bdud rigs tshogs rnams thams cad thul bas na/ /de yi tshon byed dus 'khor nas bshad pa'i/ /bdud 'dul mchod rten bzhengs par mdzad pa yin/ /'di yi nang na sku yi khru ma nyid/ /gtso bor bzhugs pas khru ma mchod rten byung / /de dus 'phags yul rdo rje gdan la sogs/ /rgya gar yul gyi gnas chen du ma ru/ /rje btsun rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i/ /sku yi sprul pa sa skyar byon no zhes/ /mkha' 'gro kun gyis mngon sum bsgrags pa la/ /rten nas snyan pa'i grags pas 'jam gling khyab/ /de mthun siṅga la yi rnal 'byor pa/ /rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi slob ma yang / /ji snyed 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan de ltar lags/ /de nas sku skyed shin tu che ba dang / /kun gyis mthong na dga' zhing yid du 'ong / /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi snying po yin pas na/ /mtshan yang kun dga' snying po zhes su gsol/ /re zhig rdo rje phyug mor gsang ba las/ /skabs cig tshe na rdo rje phyug mos thos/ /de ma khad la 'khon ston chen po la/ /khyed la rigs sras yod pa shin tu legs/ /ngo mtshar che 'o bdag la gsang ci dgos/ /da ni yum sras gnyis ka gdan drangs dgos/ /zhabs tog la sogs thams cad bdag gis byed/ /gsungs pa'i mod la 'phral du gdan drangs nas/ /gzim spyil dkar por yab yum sras bcas 'dzoms/ /bkra shis dge legs phun tshogs thams cad 'grig /rdo rje phyug mo'ang shin tu mnyes gyur te/ /sras nyid sku pang bzhes nas ngo mtshar che/ /mtshan yang don dang mthun pa 'dug go gsungs/ /de yang ma zad mthun rkyen ma lus pa/ /thams cad bu yi ma la dgos gsungs nas/ /zhing gi dkyil nas mchod zhing bya khra ma/ /gcig pu ma gtogs gzhan ma chos gzhis rnams/ /yum sras gnyis la thams cad 'bog par mdzad/

/de nas brtse chen kun dga' snying po yis/ /bla ma gnam dang dkon mchog rgyal po las/ /dam chos gsan pa rgya mtsho mthar phyin mdzad/ /brtse ba chen po dgung lo bcu gcig tsam/ /bzhes pa'i tshe na yab nyid bde bar gshegs/ /de yi rtsis la gdan sa bkod pa dang / /sku mchod gtong dang phyi rten rgyag pa gsum/ /nyin gcig nang du grub na phun tshogs 'byung / /zer ba babs pas de rnams stabs bsgrigs nas/ /gdan sar bla chen ba ri lo tsā ba/ legs par gdan drangs bkra shis mnga' gsol dang / /sku mchod rgyas pa'ang de nyin bsgrubs pa dang / /phyi rten chen po'i 'gram yang bting par mdzad/ /phyi rten chen po 'di nyid bzhugs sa yang / /dkon mchog rgyal po nyid kyi zhal chems la/ /nged kyi phung po 'di nyid grog po 'di'i/ /yas sne'i sgang zur ma gir 'bum pa gyis/ /'bum pa de yang so skye'i mchod rten dang / /mthun par byi 'o lta bu'i bzo lugs kyi/ /de yi nang du phung po 'di zhog cig /de yi rgyu mtshan grog po 'di nyid ni/ /dug sbrul thur la rgyug pa 'dra ba yi/ /sa bkra ngan pa yod pas mnan pa dang / /gnas 'di'i gzhi bdag phal cher klu yin pas/ /ma 'ongs mi rnams rtog pa rtsing pas na/ /klu yi gnod pas bar chad 'byung srid pas/ /de nyid mi 'byung rten 'brel 'di yin no/ /zhes gsungs de nyid bka' gnang ji lta bar/ /legs par grub ste bkra shis mnga' gsol dang / /rab gnas la sogs thams cad grub par mdzad/ /de rjes bla ma chen po ba ri ba/ /rin chen grags pa'i gsung las 'di skad gsungs/ /brtse ba chen po kun dga' snying po la/ /da ni dgung lo bcu gnyis tsam du phebs/ /khyed ni jo sras ngo mtshar can yin zhing / /bstan dang sems can don chen bsgrub dgos te/ /de la shes rab med na mi yong bas/ /shes rab bskyed la 'phags pa 'jam dpal dgos/ /de nyid bsgrub pa thog mar dgos pas na/

/'di la rtsol ba mdzod cig jo sras lags/ /gsungs nas 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i/ /rjes gnang khrid la sogs pa'i chos bskor rnams/ /yongs su rdzogs par legs par gnang ba na/ /de ma thag tu rdo rje phug pa 'am/ /sa chen phug pa byas kyang chog par snang / /zhal gzigs rjes su 'jam dpal brag phug zer/ /rdo rje phug pa zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ /brtse ba chen po'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ /phug pa 'di nyid cung zad chung 'dug pas/ /'di skad byas na che ru 'gro yang srid/ /gsungs te phyag gis phyogs bzhir 'phul ba na/ /da lta'i bzo 'di legs par byung ba yin/ /'di nyid rdo rje rgya gram rjes 'dra bas/ /gzim phug 'di la rdo rje phug par grags/ /de 'dra'i gnas mchog nyid du legs par bsgrubs/ /zhag 'ga' song nas bar chad mtshan ma byung / /de nyid bla mar zhus pas gnyen por ni/ /rje btsun mi g.yo mgon po'i chu bsrung sogs/ /chos bskor yongs rdzogs gnang zhing bsgrub pa na/ /bar chad bdud tshogs thams cad tshar bcad de/ /legs pa'i dngos grub phun tshogs brnyes pa ni/ /phug pa de yi dkar khung nyi ma dang / /lhan cig 'ja' tshon gur khang chen po'i dbus/ /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid mngon sum du/ /legs par zhal bstan nyid kyis 'di skad gsungs/ /tshe 'di la zhen na chos pa min/ /'khor ba la zhen na nges 'byung min/ /bdag don la zhen na byang sems min/ /'dzin pa byung na lta ba min/ /ces pa'i tshig bcad 'di dag gsungs ma thag /sa chen kun dga' snying po de nyid kyis/ /chos rnams thams cad thugs su chud pa snyam/ /nyams dang rtogs pa yar ngo'i zla bzhin rgyas/ /ji lta ji snyed thams cad thugs su chud/ /de rjes 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi thugs kha nas/ /shes rab ral gri bdun phrag byung nas ni/ /bar ma chad pa mu 'brel gcig tsar du/ /brtse ba chen po'i thugs khar thim par gyur/ /'di la brten nas 'jam dbyangs bdun brgyud rnams/

/rim par byon pa'i rgyas bshad 'og tu 'byung / /de 'dra'i gnas mchog ngo mtshar can de na/ /'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs mgon sa skya pa/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug kun dga' snying po bzhugs/ /de nyid dus kyi zhabs rjes ngo mtshar ba'ang / /da lta gnas mchog 'di ru bzhugs pa yin/ /zhabs rjes 'di la'ang rmongs pa 'ga' zhig gis/ /sngags 'chang chen po'i zhabs rjes yin pa yi/ /rgyus med rgyus gtam ham lab sna tshogs kyi/ /lo rgyus log par 'chad pa mang na yang / /'di ni brtse chen kun dga' snying po yi/ /zhabs rjes yin zhes sngags 'chang chen pos gsungs/ /spyir gyi sngags 'chang chen po de nyid dang / /rje btsun grags pa dbyer med yin par go /de yi rgyu mtshan snga mo'i dus kyi tshe/ /ngo mtshar che ba'i rdo rje phug pa 'dir/ /rang re skal ldan 'ga' re 'dus pa'i sar/ /sngags 'chang chen po'i gsung las 'di skad thos/ /nged rang bsdod sa'i phug pa 'di na yod/ /zhu yas bsdod sa pha ga de kha yin/ /gnyis ka brus dang gsungs nas brkos pa yi/ /ji ltar gsung pa bzhin du da lta'ang yod/ /de yang rje btsun chen po'i gzim phug ni/ /sgo nang lho yi rang shog de kha yin/ /zhu yas phug ni sgo nang byang phyogs kyis/ /rang shong chung ngu yin te kun gyis mthong / /rje btsun rtse mo lho yi dbus su bzhugs/ /brtse ba chen po kun dga' snying po nyid/ /bzhugs khri 'di yi steng du legs bzhugs nas/ /zab chos du ma gsung ba'i gnas yin te/ /de dus nga rang rgya 'o nyis brtsegs can/ /da lta'i dus na sngags pa rgad po gcig /gsungs pa la sogs yid ches du ma yi/ /lo rgyus ngo mtshar can rnams gsungs rjes su/ /'di na zhabs rjes gcig kyang yod rgyu yin/ /kun gyi 'tshol cig gsungs nas thams cad kyi/ /btsal bas ma brnyed rje btsun chen po des/ /brnyed par mdzad pa'ang sngon gyi thugs rgyus kyi/ /dgos pa can gyi bka' tshig yin nam snyam/

/de 'phral sku khrus gsol te phyag gnyis kyi/ /dbu thog 'jog par mdzad de rten 'brel legs/ /gsungs nas smon lam yang dag 'debs par mdzad/ /der rjes nged rang rnams la'ang byin rlabs gnang / /de nas phug pa 'di yi sgo logs g.yas/ /de na kun gyi mig gi bdud rtsir bzhugs/ /des na rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / /sngags 'chang chen po thugs rgyud gcig pa'am/ /sku yi skye ba yin pa the tshom med/ /'di bzhin kun gyi dgongs la nges shes mdzod/ /de nas sa chen kun snying de nyid kyis/ /thugs bsam mdzad pas 'di ltar thugs la 'khrungs/ /yon tan med na rigs brgyud phun tshogs kyang / /gog pa che ba skyon gyi rang bzhin yin/ /des na brang ti dar ma snying po yi/ /zhabs pad nyer bsten sbyangs pa mthar phyin zhig /nges par byed dgos dgongs nas yum la gsungs/ /yum sras bka' gros mthun par byung nas ni/ /thog mar mdo la gsan sbyong mdzad pa las/ /mdo yi phyogs la bshad gzhi che ba sogs/ /mngon pa nyid la dgongs rtse gtad pa na/ /de dus mngon pa'i 'chad nyan ngur smrig rang / /snyan grags che bas de khar phebs dgongs snyam/ /legs par dgongs te rim gyis phebs pa'i tshe/ /grwa tshogs che bas brang khang thams cad khengs/ /rje btsun nyid kyis srang kha'i zur sbug cig /yol bas legs par bcad cing bzhugs par mdzad/ /de yi nye logs zhig na yar 'brog pa'i/ /grwa pa snyoms chung zhig ni 'dug pa la/ /'brum bu rme ba nag po zhes bya ba'i/ /nad rigs gdug pa can gyis thebs par gzigs/ /de la bzod brlag med pa'i snying rje 'khrungs/ /de ma thag tu khong gi nad g.yog mdzad/ /khong nyid phan 'phral rje btsun nyid la 'gos/ /de nas shin tu snyung bar gyur pa'i dus/ /sa skyar a pho phag ston zer ba la/ /gnod sbyin yab nyid sku phebs yong ba dang / /mthong snang dag kyang sna tshogs yong ba yi/ /mi rgan gtan tshigs can cig yod pa des/

/snga dro nyi ma shar 'phral kho rang gi /nyi ma lde bar phyin nas bltas pa'i tshe/ /bra chung gong kha'i ngos la rta pa'i gzugs/ /phod kha thang zhwa gyon pa gcig 'dug nas/ /lag pa g.yas kyi rta lcag g.yob pa dang / /khyed rang sa skya pa tsho ci mno bsam/ /kun dga' snying po na yin yod do zer/ /lcag gi yang yang g.yob pa mthong ba de/ /de 'phral yum la zhus pas 'di skad gsungs/ /a po phag ston kho yi mthong snang 'di/ /shin tu bden par nges pas grabs yul gyis/ /gsungs pa bzhin du de nub bang chen sleb/ /de nas yum gyi dgongs par 'di snyam mo/ /kun snying med na nged kyi ci byed snyam/ /legs par dgongs te gser sogs yo byad kyi/ /dngos po'i rigs spyad shin tu mang ba bsnams/ /'bad rtsol drag pos bsgrubs te myur du byon/ /ngur smrig mda' yi pha bong gcig gi steng / /legs par phebs te nged kyi bu mchog de/ /ga na yod snyam gzigs par mdzad pa'i tshe/ /pha bong de la yum gyi zhabs rjes byung / /ngo mtshar can de da lta kun gyi mthong / /de nas rim gyis phebs par mdzad pa dang / /sras kyis yum nyid phebs pa'i mnyes tshor gyis/ /thugs rus bskyed de sku rgyab brten sa yi/ /pha bong chen po yod pa de nyid la/ /phyag gi khu tshur gtad cing bzhengs dgongs snyam/ /mdzad kyang snyung babs brdzis pas bzhengs ma thub/ /de ltar mdzad pas phyag rjes brag la byung / /de yang kun gyi mig gi bdud rtsir bzhugs/ /de nas yum sras mjal bar gyur pa na/ /sras nyid sku na gzhon zhing snyung ba dang / /sa thag ring bas yum la 'chang nas ni/ /spyan chab phyung zhing yus mthar mdzad pa na/ /yum gyi thugs la bden snyam dgos na yang / /she ba bcad phyir yum gyis 'di skad gsungs/ /ci zer jo sras la ni snying rus dgos/ /dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho lta bu 'di'i/ /dbus su khyod nyid she ba de rang dga'/ /gsung ba la sogs gcun thabs sna tshogs mdzad/

/de nas zla ba gnyis gsum song rjes su/ /sku khams dwangs nas yum gyis yar phebs dus/ /sras kyis yum nyid phebs bskyel mdzad pa la/ /sngar gyi yum gyis gzigs pa'i pha bong de/ /yod sar phebs nas yum sras gyes dus su/ /sras kyi yum la rjes 'brangs tshul nyid du/ /pha bong de la dbu btsugs shums pa na/ /dbu yi rjes nyid shin tu gsal ba dang / /yum gyi phyag gis bslangs pa'i phyag rjes byung / /sngar gyi zhabs rjes yang ni der yod de/ /pha bong ngo mtshar can cig de na bdog /yum sras gnyis kyi grub rtags bzhag rjes su/ /yum gyis yar byon sras kyis ngur smrig byon/ /mngon pa la sogs dam chos du ma zhig /gsan pa rgya mtsho'i mdzad tshul mtha' yas kyang / /so so'i rnam thar nang du gsal bas na/ /yi ge mang gi dogs nas re zhig bzhag /de nas rim gyis sa skyar phebs pa na/ /mdo phyogs dag ni shin tu mkhas par shes/ /da ni sngags la sbyangs pa mdzad dgongs te/ /'khon ston sgyi chu ba yi drung du phebs/ /dges pa rdo rje'i bka' dbang zhus pa yi/ /sta gon nub mo mnal lam 'di ltar byung / /srid pa'i rgya mtsho yin zer chu chen zhig /kha dog dmar zhing 'jigs pa'i nyams ldan la/ /zam pa shin tu che ba gsum 'dug pa/ /de yi rtsa bar skye bo mang po zhig /'tshogs nas bdag la sgrol 'don byed dgos zer/ /de la bdag gis de kha byed byas nas/ /zam pa gsum 'dug de yi dang po la/ /mi gsum bsgral zhing gnyis pa de la ni/ /bdun bsgral gsum pa la ni mang po zhig /legs par bsgral ba'i mtshan ltas bzang po byung / /de nyid zhang ston chen po'i skabs su 'chad/ /de nas re zhig chos bar cig gi nyin/ /mdo stod phyogs su chos 'khor chen po yi/ /dga' ston zhig la bla chen se ston nyid/ /legs par phebs 'dug ces pa'i skad cha gsan/ /spyir gyi sa chen 'di nyid blta mo sogs/ /gang la'ang mi mnyes gzigs rtog mi mdzad kyang /

/de nyin chos bar yin cing bla chen se'ang / /bzang po yin pa'i snyan grags 'dug pa na/ /ci 'dra 'dug cig blta ru 'gro dgongs nas/ /grwa pa 'ga' dang 'grogs nas phebs pa'i tshe/ /bla ma se nyid gral gyi dbus na bzhugs/ /zhal nas gsung gleng chal chol mang po gnang / /jo sras khyed rnams gang nas yong pa yin/ /yul ni gang yin bshad sgrub gang bya snyam/ /gsungs nas gzhan rnams kun la bka' stsal rjes/ /sa chen nyid la khyed rang gang nas yin/ /gsungs pa'i lan du bdag cag grom sbug pa/ /sa skya zer ba de nas yin zhus pas/ /de na nged kyi bla ma yod pas te/ /de ni sku gshegs de yi shul du ni/ /ba ri ba zhes bya ba gcig 'dug zer/ /'gro yang ma 'dod da ni sa skya na/ /ji ltar yod ces gsungs pa'i lan du ni/ /de yi bu yi dod cig bdag gcig lags/ /zhus pas bla ma'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ /de 'dra ci bden nyid rang brdzun ma zer/ /nged kyi bla mar rigs sras mi mnga' 'o/ /de skad gsungs pas sa chen kun snying ni/ /rdo rje phyug mor rigs sras med pas na/ /cung zad skyengs te zhu lan 'bul ma spobs/ /de la mched grogs rnams kyis 'di ltar zhus/ /rdo rje phyug mor med kyang zhang mo la/ /'di nyid 'khrungs dus ngo mtshar du ma dang / /bcas te kha 'ub 'og gi phug pa ru/ /legs par bltams te mtshan kyang kun snying zer/ /de skad zhus ma thag tu bla chen des/ /sa chen sku pang bzhes nas 'di skad gsungs/ /mi rnams shi gson mi 'phrad zer 'dug kyang / /shi gson 'phrad pa'i dus bzang da lan tsam/ /gsungs nas spyan chab mang po mdzad pa dang / /da ni mi rgan gog po 'di nyid la/ /gdams ngag zab dgu mang po yod pa rnams/ /snying dang 'dra ba'i skyes mchog khyed la ster/ /myur du byon cig ga le 'byon snyam na/ /nga ni sang phod 'chi rgyu yin no dgongs/ /de skad gsungs nas de nub se ston gyi/

/zhabs pad drung du dbu sngas sbrel nas zhugs/ /gsung ngag rin chen lam dang 'bras bu yi/ /dkyus gzhung sogs la 'di 'dra 'di yod kyi/ /bka' tshig rdo rje'i gsung mchog stsal ba'i tshe/ /yid gnyis the tshom med pa'i mos gus 'khrungs/ /de nas sgyi chur log nas byon pa'i rjes/ /phyag dpe la sogs sku chas gang yod rnams/ /brdeg par mdzad nas phebs grabs mdzad pa'i tshe/ /grogs mchog dga' yis 'di skad gleng bar gyur/ /de ltar 'byon pa gang nas bltas kyang ni/ /mi dge de yi rgyu mtshan 'di ltar yin/ /grwa pa mang nyung 'di kha tsam cig gi /khrod nas bla ma'i thugs la khyed rang zhugs/ /bka' drin gyis kyang rgyun du skyong ba la/ /gnang ba tsam yang ma zhus byon pa na/ /kun gyi khrel zhing bla ma'ang mi mnyes pas/ /gnang ba tsam zhig zhus nas byon pa legs/ /gsang sngags bya ba bla ma ci gsung nyid/ /byed pa 'di ni gnad kyi gdams pa yin/ /de skad zer bas shin tu bden snyam nas/ /khros po phog nas de khar bzhag rjes su/ /bla ma'i drung byon gnang ba zhus pa na/ /bla mas ci byed de 'dra mi yong ste/ /se ni lce la re zhes bya ba yin/ /nged kyi bla ma snga ris gsal snying gi /chos kyi gral grul bsdus pa phran tshegs tsam/ /de las spros pa'i gdams ngag kho la med/ /rtsab rtsob mang po chos kyi bar chad yin/ /gsungs nas bka' grol gnang ba ma byung bas/ /nyin mtshan kun tu thugs yid chad par gyur/ /'on kyang se yang da gzod cung mi gshegs/ /'dir yang gnang ba zhus rjes ma bsdad na/ /dam sel 'byung bas bsdad pa drag snyam nas/ /lo 'ga' bzhugs pa'i da gzod se ston gshegs/ /'gyod kyang bya ba'i thabs ni gcig kyang med/ /da ni ci drag snyam pa'i thugs las kyi/ /nyin mtshan kun tu thugs g.yeng che bar gyur/ /de nas re zhig sa skyar byon rjes su/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug rje btsun kha 'ub pa/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya'i skyes mchog las/

/dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa'i/ /zab chos khyad par 'phags pa du ma gsan/ /de nas lo 'ga' song rjes sa skya ru/ /chos 'khor rgyas pa gcig ni gnang dgos dgongs/ /cha rkyen phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'grigs/ /bu chen rnams kyang rags rim 'dzoms par gyur/ /de yi tshogs dbus 'khon ston sgyi chu ba/ /spyan 'dren mdzad dgos dgongs pa yod pa'i tshe/ /sgyi chu nas ni bla ma'i bang chen byung / /bla ma snyung bas myur du shog ces gsungs/ /dem thag tu thugs rtsol che ba dang / /bcas te myur du byon kyang bla ma grongs/ /zhal mjal ma thub thugs yid chad par gyur/ /'on kyang dgongs rdzogs chos 'khor rgyas par mdzad/ /zhal chems la ni khyed rang rab byung nas/ /'khon tsho'i sde 'di legs par skyong cig gsungs/ /de nas sa skyar byon nas ser chas bsgrub/ /de ltar mdzad pa bla ma gnam gyis gsan/ /de ma thag tu sa chen gdan 'dren mdzad/ /ser chas bsgrubs nas ci mdzad dri rtog mdzad/ /gong gi zhal chems byung tshul zhus pa na/ /bla ma gnam gyi bka' tshig rdo rje'i gsung / /bla ma gshin po'i kha chems 'phar ma las/ /bla ma gson po'i ngag la nyan pa dga'/ /thog mar khyed rang yong bar byed mkhan kyang / /nga rang yin te ser chas ma mdzad pa/ /rigs brgyud spel ba 'di rang ngo mtshar che/ /de skad gsungs pas brtse ba chen po des/ /bla ma'i bka' bzhin ser chas ma mdzad pa/ /'khon tsho'i sde 'di skyong bar mdzad pa yin/ /bsam bzhin bla chen gnam nyid bka' drin che/ /der rjes sgyi chur byon nas phyag dpe sogs/ /sku chas rags rim bsnams nas gung thang byon/ /bla ma mal la thams cad 'bul bar mdzad/ /zhar la bde mchog chos bskor thams cad dang / /khyad par gur gyi chos bskor ma lus gsan/ /'chams mgon la sogs ngo mtshar rten yang gnang / /'di yi zhib rgyas bka' babs bzhi yi skabs/ /legs par 'byung bas da lta ma spros so/

/de nas gdan sa chen por phebs pa'i tshe/ /dgung lo nyer brgyad bzhes pa'i dus tshod der/ /da ni bla ma se ston zhi bar gshegs/ /gsung ngag lam 'bras su la zhu snyam du/ /thugs 'dod shin tu che ba yod pa la/ /rtsad gcod mdzad pas zhang ston chen po la/ /legs par bzhugs zhes snyan grags kun gyis zhus/ /shin tu dges shing khrab cig phyag rten du/ /legs par bsnams nas sag thang ding du phebs/ /bla ma zhang ston chen po ga na bzhugs/ /gzim khang gang yin la sogs thams cad kyis/ /de ru dri rtog nan can mdzad pa na/ /zhang ston chen po nged kyis ngo mi shes/ /a jo zhang ni pha gi de ka yin/ /zer ba byung nas legs par gzigs pa'i tshe/ /thags ra mang po yod pa'i mgo zhig na/ /smad sham dmar po ra thul phyi log can/ /phyag gis yo ga mdzad cing zhal nas ni/ /shab shob 'ar 'ur mang po mdzad kyin 'dug /de khar phyin nas phyag btsal phyag rten phul/ /byin rlabs zhus pas zhang ston chen po'i bka'/ /khyod ni ga shed cig gi mi chen cig /'dra zhing chos lugs dag kyang gsar ma ba/ /yin shas che ste khyed rang ma nor ram/ /gsungs pa'i lan du bdag gis ma nor lags/ /lam 'bras gsol ba 'debs rgyu yin lags shing / /de nyid bdag la bka' drin stsal du gsol/ /de skad zhus pas 'o na da ki ru/ /ngas ni nor 'dug byas pas ma nor zer/ /da lan khyed kyi zer ba'i chos de'i ming / /ngas ni da lan min pa tshor ma myong / /thob pa dag ni ga la srid de ang / /nga ni rnying ma ba yi sngags pa yin/ /rdzogs chen tsa mun tri dang bram ze'i chos/ /de 'dra phran bu min pa mi shes pas/ /de nyid nyan la rnam rtog mi byed dam/ /phyag rten 'khyer la khyed rang song zhig gsungs/ /de tshe sa chen thugs la 'di ltar 'khrungs/ /sku yi cha lugs lhug pa mdzad lugs dang / /zhal nas kyang ni chal chol gsung lugs kyi/ /phal cher gdam ngag rang ni med par 'dra/

/snyam du dgongs shing phyag rten 'khyer nas byon/ /de nas cung zad tsam zhig song ba na/ /jo sras 'od mchog zer ba'i pha de yis/ bla ma chen po zhang ston chos 'bar la/ /bla ma zhang pa da lan 'dir byung ba'i/ /mi chen de ni nged rang yon mchod rnams/ /bla chen se yi phyag phyir yod pa'i dus/ /sgyi chu pa yi grwa pa gcig la ni/ /sku pang bzhes nas thugs rtsis mdzad pa de/ /a re 'dra ste slog par cang mchis sam/ /de skad zhus pas 'o na bos shog cig /de nyid slog na bla ma'i dam tshig rnams/ /nyams par 'gro bas myur du bos shog shig /de skad gsungs shing 'od mchog pha de yis/ /'gyogs par phyin te sa chen gdan drangs te/ /zhang ston chen pos dri rtsad mdzad pa na/ /thugs yid ches nas da ci nged rang gis/ /ngo yang ma shes brdzun yang byas pa yin/ /da ni khyod la gsung ngag los bshad de/ /da lta 'di yi stod smad thams cad na/ /lo chen lo chung mang pos bshad nyan byed/ /'di yi skabs su rgan gog chos bshad na/ /mdzes rgyu med cing mi rgan bsam mno 'dra/ /gtang dgos 'dug pas da lan khyed rang yang / /sa skyar byon la cha rkyen bsgrub par mdzod/ /da gzod sos ka 'di ru 'byon pa zhu/ /de skad gsungs nas brtse ba chen po des/ /sa skyar phebs nas cha rkyen 'dzoms par mdzad/ /de nas sos bstun sag thang ding du phebs/ /zhang ston chen pos gsung ngag 'dzugs par mdzad/ /sngon 'gro'i chos rnams song ba'i mjug tsam du/ /rje yi ljags bkrangs gsung chos gnang ma thub/ /de la rje yi gsung las 'di ltar gsungs/ /nged rang gnyis kyi bar na dam tshig gi /nyes pa cung zad 'dug pas yig brgya dang / /maṇ+ḍal gnyis la 'bad pa byed dgos so/ /gsung ma thag tu sa chen thugs dgongs la/ /gzhan ma dam tshig dag la nyes pa med/ /yin na'ang kha sing yong dus gdam ngag rang / /med pa e yin snyam pa'i snang ba byung / /de kha yin yong snyam du dgongs nas ni/

/yig brgya maṇ+ḍal gnyis la nan tan du/ /legs par mdzad pas rje nyid snyung las grol/ /de nas zab chos ma lus gnang bar mdzad/ /de skabs chos kyi gal gnad che ba rnams/ /phyag ngar la ni rde'u chung ngu yis/ /'bri bar mdzad pas de tsug ma mdzad cig /man ngag zab mo snyan brgyud kho na las/ /yi ger bris na mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad 'byung / /thugs la zhog cig skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /de skad gsungs nas 'bri ru ma gnang yang / /lo bzhi'i bar du nan tan chen pos gnang / /de nas sa chen dgung lo so gnyis kyi/ /steng du phebs nas chos rnams rdzogs rjes su/ /nyin cig snga dro thog khar byon gsungs te/ /shin tu dges pas gsung gleng zhib tu mdzad/ /de yang thog mar nged rang spun gnyis pos/ /lo ni bco brgyad bar du dka' ba spyad/ /khong gi tha snyad tshig la mkhas par sbyangs/ /nged kyi bsgom pa nyid la rtse gcig 'bad/ /de ltar byas pas bla ma bsgom la brnyes/ /phyis su lam 'bras rdo rje'i tshig rkang gis/ /go don phyin ci ma log shes pa byung / /de la brten nas khong yang yid ches nas/ /nged la bla ma bcol te tshad mar bzung / /chos 'di bsgom gyis nang nas ma grol na/ /tha snyad tshig gis rtsa mdud ga la grol/ /de phyir bsgom la 'bad 'bungs bskyed par mdzod/ /de rnams gsung rjes sku yi sprul pa yang / /sngar nas mthong ma myong ba'i ri dwags dang / /bya tshogs du ma mdzad cing rtswa rnams kyi/ /rtse mor rigs gsum mgon po ston pa dang / /skyil krung gcig gis sag thang ding nyid kyi/ /yul gru thams cad khyab par mdzad pa sogs/ /ngo mtshar can gyi bkod pa du ma rnams/ /thogs pa med par bstan nas 'di skad gsungs/ /ngas kyang bsgom la 'bad pas 'di 'dra byung / /da ni nga bas khyed rang mi zhan pas/ /sngar ni zab chos 'di ni rab chad snyam/ /byung ste da ni zab chos 'phel bar 'gyur/ /khyed cag lta bu'i yon tan phun tshogs la/

/chos 'di 'phrod pas mi rgan blo bag gro/ /shi yang 'gyod pa med do dam tshig can/ /gsungs nas zab mo'i gnad rnams thams cad kun/ /legs par rdzogs te bsgrub pa'i lung sbyin skabs/ /da ni zab chos mtha' dag sbyin zin pas/ /lo ni bco brgyad bar du chos 'di nyid/ /thos dang 'chad pa'i gnas tshul lta ci smos/ /ming tsam bton na'ang mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad nyid/ /nges par 'byung bas su la'ang 'phros ma thong / /zab mo'i gdam ngag gsang ba phan yon che/ /bco brgyad song nas skal ldan slob ma la/ /'chad dam rtsom mam yi ger 'bri ba sogs/ /khyed rang chos kyi bdag po yin pas na/ /gang byed khyed rang gang bde mdzad pas chog /spyir ni khyed kyis bsgrub pa gtsor mdzad na/ /phyag chen mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'dir thob/ /bshad pa byas kyang bstan la phan yon ni/ /bsam gyis mi khyab ngo mtshar che nges 'byung / /khrid du bskyangs na slob ma 'di ltar 'byung / /rang lus ma spangs phyag chen mchog nyid kyi/ /dngos grub thob nges gsum ni 'byung 'gyur te/ /bzod pa thob nges slob ma bdun tsam 'byung / /nyams rtogs ldan nges brgyad cu 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de skad gsungs pa de rnams sta gon gyi/ /mnal lam byung ba'i zam pa gsum po la/ /sgrol bar mdzad pa'i skal ldan de dag yin/ /de yang dang po gsum ni 'di lta ste/ /siṅga gling gi rnal 'byor chen po dang / /byang sems stag dang bsgom pa skyi 'bar ro/ /bzod pa thob pa bdun ni 'di ltar yin/ /rje btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / /zhu byas sga ston nags bsgom bsod rgyal dang / /tshar kha'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa 'od grags dang / /mang chung ma rnams yin no gzhan yang ni/ /slob ma'i tshogs ni bgrang las 'das pa byung / /de 'dra'i lung bstan bka' rgya mdzad rjes su/ /sa skyar phebs nas bka' rgya ma thim bar/ /gsang sgo dam par mdzad de bsnyel gyi dogs/

/rdo rje'i tshig rkang nyin rer tshar bdun dang / /gsung ngag rin chen dbu zhabs thams cad rnams/ /zla ba re la tshar re shar sbyangs mdzad/ /de nas re zhig song ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /snga mor bla ma mal lo chen po la/ /sgyi chu ba yi phyag dpe 'bul ba dang / /bde mchog chos bskor zhu bar phebs dus su/ /skye bo ngan pas gsol zhig byung gyur nas/ /sku khams shin tu bsnyel bar byung ba na/ /bzo mo tsi tsi zer ba'i lha mo zhig /sku mdun byung ste gsol sman phul ba yis/ /de ma thag tu sku khams bde bar byung / de nas re zhig song tshe sa chen nyid/ /dgung lo zhe bdun bzhes pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /slar yang sngar gyi dug ro lang nas ni/ /sku khams bsnyel yun shin tu ring ba yis/ /zab chos thams cad bsnyel bar gyur pa na/ /bla ma rnams ni zhing khams gzhan du gshegs/ /gzhan la dris na bshad rgyu ga la yod/ /rgya gar phyin kyang de 'dra ga nas 'byung / /da ni ci bya rtol med gyur snyam du/ /shin tu thugs khral che bar gyur pa dang / /da ni re sa bla ma min pa med/ /snyam du thugs thag bcad de bla brang nub/ /dbu rtse rnying ma zer te gnyis po gcig /de yi rgyu mtshan sa chen phug pa la/ /bla brang shar du yongs su grags pa yin/ /da lta dbu rtse rnying ma 'di nyid la/ /rnying ma'i ming 'jags bla brang nub ces pa/ /zer ba mi 'dug de dang mtshungs par ni/ /da lta bla brang shar la bla brang gi /ming 'jags gzim khang rnying mar ma grags na'ang / /don gyi bla brang shar nub zhes pa 'am/ /rnying ma rnam gnyis yin par nges shes 'drongs/ /de 'dra'i dbu rtse rnying ma'i gnas mchog tu/ /zas dang gnyid kyi 'du shes rab spangs nas/ /rtse gcig bla ma'i gsol 'debs mdzad pa na/ /nyams snang 'dra ba'i za zi de 'dra la/ /zhang ston chen po'i zab mo'i chos rnams kun/ /zur tsam gsung ba'i snang ba byung ba na/ /shin tu mnyes nas slar yang phur tshugs su/

/gsol ba drag tu btab pas mngon sum du/ /zhal gyi dkyil 'khor bstan nas zab chos rnams/ /yongs su rdzogs par gnang nas thugs bsam kun/ /bzhed don ma lus 'bad med 'grub par gyur/ /de nas re zhig song tshe sa ga yi/ /nyer gsum nyin par dpon po ri yi ngos/ /sa dkar glang chen 'gying 'dra'i dbus nyid du/ /stag lpags chen po bting pa'i gdan steng du/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug rje btsun bir+wa pa/ /sku nyams rgyas shing 'od zer du ma 'phro/ /mon grog 'bal grog gnyis kyi bar skabs der/ /skyil krung cig gis khyab par mdzad nas bzhugs/ /g.yas su kṛṣ+ṇa pa yi gdugs 'dzin cing / /g.yon du nag po pa ni rwa dung 'bud/ /gtso 'khor gsum po mngon sum zhal gzigs shing / /gtso 'khor lnga ru byed pa'ang bshad 'dug pas/ /de nyid ltar na sngar gyi gsum po'i steng / /ga ya dha ra bi na sa gnyis bsnan/ /de ltar byas pas gtso 'khor lnga gzigs ste/ /rgyud sde chen po bdun cu rtsa gnyis dang / /gzhan yang zab chos du ma gnang dus su/ /gdan sa chen po'i lcags ri'i khong nyid las/ /phyir mi 'da' ba'i zab chos bzhi yang gnang / /de sogs ngo mtshar du ma'i gzigs snang yang / /byung pa 'di ni dbu rtse rnying ma las/ /gzhan du 'chad pa mun 'khrul dag tu zad/ /de yi rgyu mtshan zhu byas dngos grub kyi/ /brtse ba chen po'i rnam thar bstod pa las/ /bi ṣa'i nad kyis cung zad snyung ba las/ /thugs la mnga' ba thams cad bsnyel bar gyur/ /grogs la dri sa med cing rgya gar du/ /byon kyang ji ltar yod pa cha med nas/ /dbu rtse rnying mar mtshams mdzad bla ma dang / /dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba drag tu btab/ /bsnyel ba gsos zhing thugs kyis nges par gyur/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug chos 'chad phyag rgya can/ /ku mud ltar dkar sa yi rgyab yol mdzad/ /'bal grog yan nas mon grog man chad du/ /skyil krung gcig gis khebs mdzad 'di dbang gsungs/

/da lta'i mkhar lan 'byung ba'i rten 'brel yin/ /rgyud sde bdun cu rtsa gnyis legs gsungs shing / bla ma'i rnal 'byor gegs sel gnad rnams dang / /lam ni sbas bshad grub chen bcu la sogs/ /rnam 'joms bir lugs kyai rdor lus dkyil dang / /bir+wa pa yi dbang dang byin rlabs mchog /lam zab bla ma la sogs du ma gsungs/ /de yi 'khor bzhi bzhugs pa 'di ltar ste/ /nag po pa ni mnyam gzhag rwa dung 'bud/ /ga ya dha ra thugs khar rdor dril bsnol/ /ko ṭa lam pa rtog rtse pa rgyab tu gdugs 'dzin cing / /bi na sa nags khrod pa ni mdun nas bdud rtsi 'dren/ /de ltar 'di ni zhal gzigs rnam 'gyur yin/ /mtshal khar lo gsum bzhugs nas khrid bskyangs shing / /sa skyar gsung ngag rin chen gsungs pa dang / /gung thang du ni mal gyi nye gnas mdzad/ /'brig 'tshams 'gro la byams gling lha khang du/ /nam mkha' dri med dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas/ /rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga mdzad pa dang / /zangs gdong 'brog sib gsung ngag rin chen gsungs/ /sgo lngar chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba rnams/ /lo zla tshes grangs gcig par 'dug ces grags/ /sku yi bkod pa drug tu bstan pa yin/ /dbang rgyud gzhung 'grel man ngag kun mnga' zhing / /rgyud 'grel sgrub thabs dkyil chog man ngag sogs/ /phul du phyin pa'i rtsom pa dag kyang mdzad/ /gdul bya mtha' dag smin par mdzad pa yin/ /de skad gsungs phyir rnal 'byor dbang phyug nyid/ /zhal gzigs ngo mtshar phun tshogs byung ba'i gnas/ /dbu rtse rnying ma kho na yin pa ni/ /sngags 'chang chen po'i gsung las nges par thos/ /de'i rgyu mtshan gong gis gsal bar dgongs/ /gzhan yang snyan ngag dbang po'i nyer mtsho las/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug snang byed bdag po yis/ /rgyud sde'i 'od zer brgya phrag du ma rnams/ /rab tu 'gyed par mdzad nas gdul bya yi/ /blo gros 'dab stong 'byed pa'i dga' tshal yin/

/de ltar gsungs 'dug thugs gzhig mdzad pa zhu/ /de dang mtshungs par 'jam dpal gzigs pa yang / /bla brang shar gyi rdo rje phug pa las/ /gzhan du 'chad pa gong dang mtshungs pa yin/ /'jam dpal gzigs dang bla ma bsten tshul rnams/ /gong gi rnam thar bstod pa de nyid las/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i bla ma sa chen de/ /skye ba du mar tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i mthus/ /'od gsal lha rigs 'khon gyi gdung du 'khrungs/ /bcu gnyis lon tshe bcom ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /mngon sum zhal gzigs de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thog mar yab dang ba ri lo chen dang / brang ti dar ma zur chen byang chad khyung / /khyung ni rin chen grags dang me lhang chos kyi 'byung gnas zer 'tsher/ /kha'u pa dang sgyi chu dgra lha 'bar/ /mal gyo lo tsā pu hrang lo chung dang / /skyu ra a skyabs rdo rje gdan pa che/ /bal po pad+ma dz+nyā na badz+ra dang / /dge bshes rngog dang mnga' brnyes chos 'bar te/ /bla ma dam pa bsten cing grub pa brnyes/ /shes bya phal cher 'bad pa chung ngus mkhyen/ /gsung ngag rin chen lam dang 'bras bur bcas/ /shin tu zab pa'i gdam ngag phul du phyin/ /bka' rgya grol nas 'grel pa bcu gcig mdzad/ /ces sogs rgyas par gsungs pa de dag rnams/ /bla ma bsten dang yi dam lha yi tshogs/ /zhal gzigs lung bstan brnyes pa'i ngo mtshar gtam/ /mdor bsdus tsam zhig legs par brjod pa yin/ /de yang rnam 'grel bcu gcig mdzad tshul ni/ /bka' rgya thim pa'i lo yi dus tshod der/ /byang chub sems dpa' a seng zhes bya bas/ /brtse ba chen po kun dga' snying po la/ /gsung ngag rin chen gdams pa zab mo de/ /khyed kyi thugs la mnga' yang mi gsungs par/ /da res tshar gcig bdag la gsungs pa dang / /yi ge zhig ni cis kyang mdzad pa zhu/ /de skad gsol ba btab pas bla chen gyis/ /thugs gzhig mdzad tshe bka' rgya thim pa dang / /khong gis gsol ba btab pa gnyis 'dzoms pa/

/bla mas rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin snyam du/ /dgongs nas khong la tshar gcig gsungs pa'i rjes/ /rnam 'grel dang po a seng ma zhes pa/ /legs par mdzad cing de rjes gzhung bshad ni/ /snyag ma klog kyang zhu byas yum sras dang / /zla rgyal bzang ldan 'a 'u ldan bu dang / /sga theng ma zhes bya ba bcu gcig mdzad/ /de nas gsung ngag rin chen bstan pa ni/ /kha ba can 'dir che cher dar bar mdzad/ /skal ldan slob ma bskrun pa'i rnam thar ni/ /mchog thob gsum dang bzod thob bdun la sogs/ /gong du brjod pas 'dir ni ma smos so/ /khyad par sku lus ma spangs mkha' spyod gshegs/ /mi thub zla ba'i sprul pa la sogs pa/ /slob ma yang slob nying slob bgrang yas pa/ /byung ba'i tshul rnams mi nyag paṇ+ḍi ta/ /mkhas mchog grags pa rdo rje zhes bya des/ /gong gi rnam par bstod pa'i kha skong du/ /'di skad gsungs 'dug dgongs gzhig mdzad pa zhu/ /gzhon nu'i sa la gnas pa'i slob ma ni/ /mkha' spyod dbang po bsod nams rtse mor grags/ /gzhan yang bdag nyid de yi slob ma ni/ /brtul shugs grub pa dpal chen sga lo dang / /byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan dang / /dpal ldan phag mo grub pa chen po dang / /bsgom chen nya rgan rnal 'byor phag ston sogs/ /grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes chen du ma dang / /rta nag 'khrungs pa'i rgyal tsha ral phug pa/ /'o yug 'khrungs pa'i g.yar ston sbu ma ba/ /g.yor stod byon pa'i gshen rdor seng ge dang / /yar lung 'khrungs pa'i gshen ston dgon dkar ba/ /'on du byon pa'i zhang ston gsum thag pa/ /brag dmar gzhu dang zhang ston spe dmar ba/ /skyu ra a skyabs de sras a seng dang / /gnam du byon pa'i ne tsho sbal ston dang / lho brag dkar ston lcags kyi rdo rje dang / gsang phu'i mkhas pa mdzangs ston 'dza' ne dang / /thugs sras dam pa bsod nams rdo rje dang / gnyan phul chung par grags/

mtshan gtsug tor rgyal po'ang zer/ gnya' ston dbang rgyal rgya bsgom tshul khrims grags/ /mi nyag ston pa pradz+nyā dz+wa la dang / /khams pa sga theng 'a 'u ma la sogs/ /rmi lam na yang 'dod la ma chags shing / /rgyud sde'i snying po rim gnyis lhur len pa'i/ /mkhas grub dam pa mu mtha' bral ba yi/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can dpal dang ldan par byas/ /sga lo'i slob ma g.yu grags pa la sogs/ /zla rgyal slob ma nyin phug pa la sogs/ /phag gru'i slob ma 'bri stag gling gsum sogs/ /rgyal tsha'i slob ma ri ma gces bsgom sogs/ /a seng slob ma cha tsha nyang ran sogs/ /rje pa'i slob ma sa skya paṇa chen dang / /grags pa'i mtha' can brgyad la sogs pa ste/ /shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i mtha' klas dam pa rnams/ /thugs rje che ldan de yi slob brgyud lags/ /zhing 'di'i gdul bya'i don mdzad thugs rang nas/ /sa stag tha skar yar gyi bcu bzhi tshe/ /g.yas ru skya'o kha gdangs zhes bya bar/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro nam mkha'i khams gang bas/ /bsam yas ngo mtshar bkod pas legs bsus nas/ /rnam dag zhing du gshegs pa'i tshul bstan tshe/ /sku yi bkod pa rnam bzhir bstan pa las/ /gcig ni zhing mchog bde ba can du gshegs/ /gnyis pa lho phyogs gru 'dzin gnas su gshegs/ /gsum pa 'phur u rgyan 'gro rdo rje'i gnas su gshegs/ /bzhi pa byang phyogs gser mdog can gshegs par/ /spyan sngar bzhugs pa bsod nams rtse mo dang / /grags pa rgyal mtshan zhu byas dngos grub sogs/ /grub chen rnams kyis gsal bar dngos su gzigs/ /'di ni nges par 'jig rten dbang phyug nyid/ /de yi longs sprul rnam gnyis bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /bde ba can dang po ta la nyid yin/ /de phyir de 'dra'i gzigs snang bstan par nges/ /gsang ba'i mdzod kun gang gi phyag gnas dang / /sras kyi thu bo'i zhing khams yin pa'i slad/ /zhing khams phyi ma gnyis su gshegs sam snyam/ /gang tshe spur bzhu zhen pa de yi tshe/

/kun gyi 'khor lo bde mchog zhal bzhi par/ /gsal bar mthong zhing skal ldan la las ni/ /zhal brgyad dges pa rdo rje gsal bar mthong / /rgyal ba kun gyi rigs bdag rdo rje 'chang / /'dzam gling mkhas grub kun gyi gtsug na mdzes/ /snyan pa'i ba dan sa gsum rab gsal ba/ /gang de'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pa de dag kyang / /'khrul med yin no nges shes ldan par mdzod/ /dge ba cung zad rgyas par 'phros song yang / /sa chen rnam thar 'chad pa'i skabs yin pas/ /nyes pa med snyam kho bos brjod pa yin/ /des na byin rlabs gzi 'od 'bar ba yi/ /phug pa 'di la sa chen phug pa zer/ /de 'dra'i gnas mchog khyad par 'phags pa'i dbus/ /sngar gyi bzhugs khri chung ngu 'dug pa de/ /nang gi gzungs gzhug tshul du legs bzhugs nas/ /de yi phyi la sngags 'chang chen po yis/ /bzhugs khri gsar bzhengs yid 'ong ldan pa'i steng / /sa 'jam gnyis kyi sku 'dra ngo mtshar can/ /byin rlabs gzi 'od 'bar ba 'di nyid ni/ /'gro ba kun gyi 'dren pa dam par bzhugs/ /de dag la ni dbang po'i nyer 'tsho las/ /bla med bla ma'i bla brang phun tshogs ni/ /nyin byed pad+mo'i tshal du shar ba 'am/ /kun nas bkod legs mngon dga'i zhing khams ltar/ /sna tshogs rin chen mchog tu 'khrigs pa can/ /rab brjid ri rgyal lta bur lhun stug pa'i/ /dpag yas gtsug lag khang bzang mtho ba'i rtser/ /gser zangs gyen du 'phur ba'i 'gan ji ra/ /bcu gnyis bdag pos gzi 'od 'bar ba dang / /grwa bzhir ston zla'i dpal ster seng ges mtshan/ /yang na kun gzigs pho brang bgrang yas las/ /khang bzang 'di ni sngon gyi rgyal ba'i zhing / /de slad sa chen 'di na nyi ma'i gnyen/ /ji bzhin kun mkhyen bla ma chen po yis/ /'gro la rab dga'i dpal ster zab don gyi/ /snying po mchog tu brnyes pa'i rdo rje phug /rdo rje'i gdan 'dir rgyal ba'i yab gcig pu/

/gzhon nu'i tshul 'chang 'jam dbyangs chos grwa ste/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang 'dod pa'i skal ldan rnams/ /rdo rje theg pa'i zab lam sgor zhugs nas/ /rdo rje'i gdan 'dir nyams su longs shig dang / /rdo rje'i sku nyid myur du 'grub bo kye/ /yang na skal ldan byang chub thob 'dod rnams/ /dam pa gang dang gang la dad pa dag /phul byung kun nas kun tu byung dus su/ /zung 'jug bde chen ye shes cher skyes te/ /yang dag mtha' dang rnam par lhan byas nas/ /mthar thug 'bras bu sku gsum lhun grub 'gyur/ /'di ni ji lta bzhin du yid kyis gzigs/ /gtso bo mgon po mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /kun mkhyen mkhyen pas legs par bsgrub pa yis/ /dga' bde bde legs ster ba byed pa 'di/ /gzhi dang snying po phun tshogs me tog gis/ /brgyan pa'i zhing khams 'di 'dra e ma mtshar/ /zhes gsungs 'di ni rdo rje phug pa yi/ /lo rgyus rags pa tsam zhig brjod pa yin/ /'di yi byang na phag mo phug pa yod/ /de yi lo rgyus thung tsam brjod pa na/ /'gro ba'i mgon po phag mo grub pa de/ /da lta rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i/ /sku yi sprul pa 'khrul med yid ches pa/ /sa skyar bzhugs zhes snyan pa'i grags pa yis/ /'dzam gling sa steng thams cad khyab par gsan/ /gsan ma thag tu sngon gyi bag chags nyid/ /legs par sad de skad cig de nyid la/ /gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skyar byon/ /bla chen mjal bas mi phyed dad pa thob/ /de nas rim gyis gsung ngag rin po che/ /lam dang 'bras bur bcas pa'i gdams pa mchog /legs par gsol ba btab pas yongs rdzogs gnang / /khrid yig gcig kyang khong gi don du gsung / /de yi ming la gzhung bshad phag gru ma/ /zer ba deng sang mkhas blun yongs la grags/ /de nas phag gru khams pa rdor rgyal gyis/ /phag mo phug par thugs rus bskyed de bsgom/ /de dus bla ma chen pos nyin re bzhin/

/nyams rtogs ci byung bskor bar mdzad pa'i tshe/ /nyin cig dus su bla mas phag gru la/ /dge sbyor 'phel lam mthun rkyen 'dzoms sam gsungs/ /de la phag gru'i zhu lan 'di ltar phul/ /dge sbyor 'phel zhing mthun rkyen gzhan rnams kun/ /'dzoms par byung ste chu nyid cung zad tsam/ /len thag ring zhes zhus pas bla chen gyis/ /de 'dra dka' las cig kyang yod ma yin/ /gsungs nas khong rang bzhugs sa'i phug pa de'i/ /nub byang 'tshams kyi gad phug de nyid du/ /ljags chab btab nas de na chu 'dug pa/ /gsungs pa'i mod la skad cig de nyid la/ /bsgrub chu yan lag brgyad ldan byung ba yin/ /'di la'ang rgyus med rgyus gtam byed pa yis/ /rmongs pa phal cher phag mo bsgrub chu zer/ /la la phug pa'ang phag mo phug pa min/ /zer ba la sogs kun slong bsam ngan gyis/ /rang rang phyogs zhen byed pa mang yod kyang / /de dag thams cad mun 'khrul kho nar zad/ /des na legs bshad snyan brgyud rdo rje'i gsung / /'di ltar yin no skal ldan rna ba nyon/ /phug pa 'di ni phag mo phug pa yin/ /bsgrub chu 'di ni sa chen bsgrub chu yin/ /de 'dra'i spu ris gang yang ma phyed pa'i/ /long ba 'khar 'dzugs byed rnams dgod re bro/ /'di 'dra'i dogs dpyod yang dag byed 'dod tshe/ /yang na bla ma dam pa'i snyan brgyud dgos/ /yang na gong ma'i gsung rab tshad ldan sogs/ /de dang de yi yig cha gang yin la/ /thos bsam sgom gsum byed pa gnad du che/ /de nas 'gro mgon phag mo grub pa des/ /nyin mtshan g.yel ba med par bsgom pa yis/ /nyams rtogs thams cad gong 'phel yod pa'i skabs/ /rje btsun chen po rnal 'byor dbang phyug ste/ /grub pa'i gtsug rgyan mi la ras pa dang / /de yi thugs sras ras chung rdo rje grags/ /dpon slob gnyis pos phag gru'i sgo 'gag tu/ /ḍ+wa bcom byas pas phag mo grub pa nyid/ /sngon gyi bag chags sad de skad cig la/

/dran pas ma zin phug po de nyid nas/ /har lang rgyab te phyi sgo'i nang du sleb/ /de nas dran pa zin te bla ma la/ /gnang ba ma zhus phyin na bar chad 'gyur/ /snyam nas phag gru nang du log pa na/ /rje btsun chen po mi la ras pa de/ /mngon par mkhyen pas dgongs nas ras chung par/ /bu gcig yod pa de ni tsha bor song / /da ni rang re gnyis po phyin pa drag /gsungs nas snang ba gdong gtad had de byon/ /phag mo phug pa'i lo rgyus de ltar yin/ /bsgrub chu 'di ni byin rlabs che ba tsam/ /ma yin gzhan yang ngo mtshar du ma yod/ /dam nyams byung na skad cig nyid la skam/ /sa yang rlan gsher yod pa gcig kyang med/ /dam tshig ldan pa'i skal ldan las 'phro can/ /byung na skad cig nyid la chu chen 'bab/ /de sogs brtag dpyad khyad par 'phags pa yod/ /bsgrub chu ngo mtshar phun tshogs de 'dra bdog /ya mtshan che ba'i phug pa 'di nyid na/ /brtse ba chen po'i sku 'dra rnying ma dang / /phag gru sa lo sngags 'chang chen po ste/ /byin rlabs che ba'i sku 'dra de dag ni/ /'gro ba kun gyi skyabs mchog dag tu bzhugs/ /de ni phag mo phug pa'i lo rgyus lags/ /da ni bka' babs bzhi yi byung tshul las/ /bka' 'bab dang po bse mgon yin pas na/ /de yi lo rgyus rnam grangs mang na yang / /yid ches gdeng thob rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /sngags 'chang chen po'i gsung las 'di ltar 'byung / /dang po mgon po 'di yi sku rgyu ni/ /spyir gyi rgya gar chos kyi rgyal po dang / /du ru ka ni lo ka'i rgyal po ste/ /rgyal po de gnyis thog mar grogs mched byas/ /shin tu mdza' zhing mthun par yod pa las/ /re zhig tshe na rgya gar rgyal po des/ /du ru ka yi rgyal por yig rten la/ /gos dar las grub bsrub med gos shig la/ /snying khar ri mo rkang rjes 'dra ba zhig /yod pa skyes su bkur bas sdig rgyal de/ /rab tu khros te kho yi rkang pa nyid/

/nga yi snying khar brdeg ces zer ba'i brda'/ /'di ni shin tu mi 'thad myur du ni/ /dmag gi tshogs rnams da lta grabs kyis zer/ /de ma thag la dmag rgyab chos rgyal bcom/ /de yi dus su nang pa thams cad bros/ /ri sul nags gseb gang byung dag la bsdad/ /de tshe rdo rje gdan gyi chos skyong tsho'ang / /gaṇ+ḍi phrag par bkal nas bros byung bas/ /paṇ+ḍi ta yi tshogs kyis 'di skad zhus/ /khyed rnams ye shes spyan ldan yin pa la/ /gzugs can mi dang 'dra bar bros pa na/ /ngo yang tsha mod dam nyams sgrol la shog /de skad smras pas mgon tshogs kun na re/ /spyir gyi chos skyong dam nyams bza' ba la/ /shin tu dga' na'ang sdig rgyal 'di nyid kyi/ /gshin rje gshed la hriḥṣ+ṭhi khri phrag ni/ /bcu dang lnga yi lhag pa song 'dug pas/ /da lta nged rnams cung zad yongs pa yin/ /kho yi bsod nams nyams pa'i las ngan zhig /byas ma thag tu nged rnams hab sha byed/ /gzigs par zhu zhig grub pa'i dbang phyug rnams/ /de khad zhus ma thag tu sdig rgyal kho/ /bsam ngan skyes nas rdo rje gdan du phyin/ /rten gyi gtso bo mahā bo dhī yi/ /sku brnyan yod par 'di nyid rgyu gang yin/ /snyam nas snyug gris gzhogs te bltas pa na/ /kho yi bsod nams thams cad skad cig la/ /nyams par shes nas chos skyong 'khor bcas rnams/ /sau dang hūm̐ phaṭ nga ro 'brug ltar ldir/ /rgyob gsod zer zhing sprin phung 'thib pa ltar/ /'dus nas skad cig nyid la sdig rgyal bsgral/ /de tshe paṇa chen grub thob kun 'tshogs nas/ /chos skyong rnams la gtang rag rgyas pa phul/ /de rjes kho yi sha lpags rus pa rnams/ /thugs rtog zhib pos cung zad ma 'khyar ba/ /mdzad nas sku 'bag bzhengs pa'i cho ga dang / /bde byed go chas gtso mdzad rgya gar gyi/ /paṇa chen lnga brgya'i phyag bzo 'khrul med yin/ /de yang lpags pa brgyangs nas bse bzos pa/ /de la sku 'bag 'di nyid bsgrub pa dang /

/sha rus la sogs lhag ma gang yod la/ /byin gyis brlabs nas mi mgo'i do shal sogs/ /gang la ci 'tshams legs par bzhengs pa yin/ /bse 'bag zer ba'i rgyu mtshan de ltar lags/ /de nyid grub ma thag tu nam mkha' nas/ /me tog sngon po shin tu yid 'ong gcig /legs par babs nas sku la thim pa na/ /de yi mod la sku mdog mthing nag la/ /'od zer me ltar 'bar ba mngon sum mthong / /de ni nag po zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan lags/ /der rjes rdo rje gdan gyi byang sgo yi/ /srung mar paṇa chen lnga brgya'i mnga' gsol dang / /rab gnas bkra shis mdzad de bzhugs pa la/ /kha cig 'di la sangs rgyas 'od srung dang / /shākya thub gnyis kas rab gnas mdzad zer ba'i/ /bshad tshod 'dug kyang 'di ni ji ltar yin/ /de yi rgyu mtshan rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul/ /rdo rje gdan gyi gtsug lag rten gsum rnams/ /ston pa mya ngan 'das pa'i rjes su ni/ /rgan mo ma bu gnyis kyis bzhengs pa yi/ /lo rgyus bden na gong gi bshad tshod 'khrul/ /bdag ni mthong rgya chung bas los yin nam/ /gong ma'i snyan brgyud 'dug pa'ang ma thos so/ /de nas re zhig bod kyi bsod nams la/ /chos skyong 'di nyid 'byon pa'i dus babs tshe/ /lo chen rin chen bzang po zhes bya ba'i/ /skyes mchog de la grub thob chen po gang / /shadha ka ra warma zhes byas gnang / /de nas spyan 'dren zhu bar brtsams pa las/ /snga ris stod du 'phur te byon pa yin/ /de ni 'phur shes zer ba'i rgyu mtshan lags/ /de nas rin chen bzang pos brag steng pa/ /yon tan tshul khrims nyid la gnang ba'i tshe'ang / /gong bzhin 'phur nas glo bo brag steng du/ /legs par byon rjes chos skyong bzhugs khri dang / /sku rgyab rjes kyang da lta'i bar du ni/ /shin tu gsal bar skye bo kun gyis mthong / /yon tan tshul khrims zhes bya'i sngags 'chang gis/ /bla chen mal gyo blo gros grags pa la/

/legs par gnang tshe'ang gong bzhin 'phur nas ni/ /gung thang na la rtse yi gtsug lag khang / /mahā kā la'i gnas mchog tu phebs te/ /de nas brtse chen kun dga' snying po yi/ /phyag tu legs par babs pa yin no kye/ /de yi lo rgyus cung zad spros pa na/ /brtse ba chen po kun dga' snying po des/ /na la rtse ru bla chen mal lo la/ /zab chos gsan par legs par phebs pa'i tshe/ /thog mar bde mchog chos bskor gsan par mdzad/ /de yi dus su sa chen ma gtogs pa/ /dpon slob 'ga' yi sngags btu mdzad pa la/ /sa chen gyis gzigs dka' las che ba yi/ /snang tshul gzigs tshe de la 'di lta bu/ /dka' las med pa 'dra tshul zhus pa'i tshe/ /mal lo de nyid thugs ru nga bas na/ /shes na bsam pas mi shes ma shes na/ /bsam pa tshos ni de ma khad la shes/ /la las mi tshe'i chos rnams la la yi/ /tshar re'i shes pa 'di 'dra gang yin ang / /gsungs nas cung zad bkyon pa'i tshul bstan pas/ /sa chen cung zad skyengs pa'i rnam pa yis/ /chos grwa de yi pha tshad gad phug cig /'dug sa de ru nga yi ma shes snyam/ /thugs las mdzad cing cung zad bzhugs pa'i dus/ /skor 'tshub 'dra ba'i rlung po chen po gcig /lang te phyag dpe thams cad 'khyer ba'i tshe/ /dpon slob thams cad phyag dpe 'tshol ba yi/ /thugs g.yengs shin tu che bar gyur na yang / /phyag dpe shog lde gcig kyang brnyed ma gyur/ /phyag dpe tsho ni gcig kyang ma gyag par/ /thams cad brtse ba chen po bzhugs sar babs/ /de ma khad la phyag dpe kun bsnams nas/ /mal gyo nyid la 'bul du phebs pa'i tshe/ /las 'phro cung zad yod pa yin nyan che/ /gsungs ba tsam las gzhan ni bka' mi stsal/ /de nas sa skyar phebs bzhugs gnang ba'i dus/ /'o na khyod rang byon pas chog par gnang / /nged kyi zab chos bshad pa de dag la/ /dkyil 'khor yin zer phub gog gcig gi steng / /sa dkar gcig gi pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris/

/de yi steng du bum pa yin zer nas/ /blu gu'i ske la bal 'dab dkris pa yi/ /mgul chings yin zer zog gi mgo bo bskor/ /de 'dra ma byed nged kyi chos nyams 'gro/ /gsang sngags bya ba lag len gtsang dgos so/ /de la sogs pa zhi drag gnyis ka yis/ /gsung gi bdud rtsi legs par gnang ba la/ /brtse chen de yi zhus lan 'di ltar phul/ /zog chos byed pa'i gang zag bdag min pas/ /de 'dra gang nas byed lags bla ma rang / /ye shes spyan gyis yang yang gzigs 'tshal lo/ /zhes zhus de nas lho lam brgyud de phebs/ /phebs sa kun tu jo sras sa skya pa/ /phebs kyi yod 'dug zer ba'i snyan grags kyis/ /gang phebs sa ru brnyed bkur zhabs tog dang / /rin chen gser gyi 'bul ba mang dag byung / /de nas gdan sa chen por phebs pa'i tshe/ /gser rnams kun la gzigs rtog legs par ni/ /mdzad pas gser srang chen po bcu bdun tsam/ /byung ba de nyid de ma khad la ni/ /sngags pa gcig btang bla chen mal lo la/ /legs par 'bul bskyel byed par phyin pa na/ /mal lo de nyid tshogs gral chen po zhig /tshogs pa de yi dbus na bzhugs 'dug pa/ /sngags pa yis ni bla ma'i nye gnas la/ /'phrin du bkur te bla mar mjal zhus pas/ /za 'dod yin yong bza' btung byin la zhog /cung zad cig nas 'phrad yong zer ba lob/ /de skad gsungs pa lta bu sngags pa la/ /legs par gleng bas sngags pa bang chen des/ /za 'dod ma yin 'bul ba phran bu bdog /de skad zhus dang byas nas slar zhus pas/ /'bul ba ga 'dra yod ces dris la shog /gsungs pa ltar du bang chen la bsgyur bas/ gser gyi 'bul ba phran bu zhig ni bdog /de ltar zhus ma thag tu bla chen rang / /khri las myur bar bzhengs te sngags pa la/ /gang tsam yod ces blta rtog tshul gyis gsungs/ /khong gi gser srang bcu bdun yod zhus pas/ /bla ma rang gi mgul gyi khug mag nas/ /gser srang gang pa gcig kyang bton byung nas/

/'o na 'di yang bsnon la tshogs dbus su/ /gser srang bco brgyad yod ces ngo so dang / /bcas te legs par phul cig gsungs rjes su/ /bla ma nyid rang tshogs la 'gyogs par phebs/ /khyed rang rim gyis shog cig gsungs pa ltar/ /bslab ston ji bzhin khong gis phul ba na/ /tshogs pa thams cad ha las ngo mtshar gyur/ /bla chen rang yang shin tu dges par gyur/ /tshogs chen grol nas sngags pa bang chen la/ /shin tu dges shing dri rtsad mang po gnang / /khyad par zhus lan rdzong thar gnang dus su/ /'o na khyed rang ci rtsol gyis la rgyug /khong la mi rgan 'di skad zer gyi lob/ /na ning nged kyi cung zad ma shes 'dug /slob ma snod ldan khyad par 'phags pa'i mchog /yin pa ma shes da ni dam tshig pa/ /yin par nges so snying gi bu mchog khyed/ /skor cig yar la nges par 'byon pa zhu/ /chos kyi 'phro dang 'chams mgon ngo mtshar ba/ /'bul rgyu bdog pas myur du phebs zhus cig /ces gsungs bang chen gyis kyang myur bar 'ong / /sa skyar slebs te ji ltar gsungs pa rnams/ /bla chen kun dga' snying po'i snyan phul bas/ /shin tu dges shing sngags pa bang chen la/ /legs so'i bya dga' chen po gnang bar mdzad/ /de nas bla chen mal gyis bka' gnang bzhin/ /brtse ba chen po kun dga' snying po des/ /lam gyi dka' ba khyad du sad nas ni/ /myur bar na la rtse ru phebs pa'i tshe/ /mjal 'phrad phun sum tshogs pa grub rjes su/ /bla chen gsung las khyed nyid dam tshig pa/ /khyad par can du 'dug kyang nged rang gis/ /ngo ma shes pas cung zad 'gyang ste mchis/ /'on kyang da ni mi rgan 'di nyid kyi/ /khog pa'i nang na snying nang khrag 'dra ba'i/ /zab chos mang po yod pas gsan pa 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs thugs kyi nying khu ma lus pa/ /legs par gnang zhing khyad par mgon po yi/ /chos bskor mtha' dag rdzogs par gnang ba'i rjes/ /rjes gnang skabs su sku yi rjes gnang dus/

/'chams mgon yid bzhin nor bu 'di gnang ste/ /chos skyong nyid la bka' bsgo 'di ltar mdzad/ /da ni mi rgan nga la khyod mi dgos/ /khyod rang jo sras kun dga' snying po yi/ /phyis bzhin song la dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa sde dang gdung brgyud 'khor bcas srungs/ /de skad gsungs nas mi la mi gtod pa/ /bzhin du chos skyong phyag dang sa chen gyi/ /phyag gnyis sbrel bar mdzad pas mgon po yis/ /hūm̐ phaṭ la sogs bzhad sgra cher sgrags pas/ /khams gsum ma lus thams cad skrag par mdzad/ /de ni chos skyong sku yi dam tshig yin/ /gnyis pa gsung gi rjes gnang mdzad dus su/ /dar nag dag la sha sa na bris pa/ /legs par gnang ste 'di ni gsung gi rten/ /gsum pa thugs kyi rjes gnang gnang dus su/ /lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu legs gnang ba/ /'di ni thugs kyi rten yin yon tan dang / /'phrin las rten du man ngag zab dgu rnams/ /legs par bsdus pa'i be'u bum ma lus te/ /bse yi ga 'u 'od zer 'bar ba rnams/ /legs par gnang ste ci bsam thams cad 'grub/ /de nas rim gyis 'chams mgon dang bcas te/ /la stod brgyud cing phebs par mdzad pa'i tshe/ /grang so'i stod kyi lam chen de nyid la/ /da lta 'gong lam zer ba sgra don 'chugs/ /'di ni 'gong lam ma yin mgon lam yin/ /'chams mgon phebs pa'i lam nyid yin pa dang / /shin tu 'drongs pas thig dang mtshungs 'dra yod/ /de yi phyir na mgon po'i thig lam zer/ /de dang mtshungs par grang so'i la yi ming / /da lta khro bo zhes pa gong dang 'dra/ /khra bo ma yin khro bo yin par ni/ /khro bo'i rgyal po mahā kā la nyid/ /legs par phebs pas grang so khro bo la/ /de 'dra'i la yi phar ngos de nyid nas/ /'grul pa la sogs su yang mi 'dug pas/ /'chams mgon 'di nyid 'chams zhing rim gyis byon/ /la de'i tshur phyogs nas 'ong 'grul pa zhig /yong pa de dang la zer rtse 'dzoms pas/
