/'grul pa de nyid skad cig de nyid la/ /kha nas khrag skyugs la ze de ru shi/ /chos skyong gnyan pa'i grags pas sa steng khyab/ /de nas rim gyis zhal khebs la sogs pas/ /legs par dril nas kun gyis mi mthong bar/ /gsang zhing sba ba'i tshul gyis spyan drangs te/ /sgo rum gzim spyil dkar por phebs pa'i tshe/ /da lta bzhugs sa'i gzim khang 'di nyid du/ /cung zad bzhugs bcug de nas mgon khang sogs/ /zhal bkod mdzad nas bzhugs su gsol snyam pas/ /chos skyong nyid kyis gsung byon 'di skad gsungs/ /bsdod sa 'di kha rang gi yong ba 'dug /rdo rje gdan gyi byang sgo'ang 'di nas non/ /bstan pa bsrung la'ang 'di kha phan yon che/ /zhes sogs gsungs te da lta'i bzhugs sa 'dir/ /kun gyi bsgul bskyod ma nus de khar bzhugs/ /bzhugs lugs nyid kyang 'drongs po ma yin pa'i/ /sngon ma gang bzhag de gar 'jog pa mdzad/ /de ma thag tu brtse ba chen po yis/ /gtum chen ma zhes bya ba'i bskang gso mdzad/ /sgo rum zhes pa'i sgra bshad mang na yang / /yid brtan thub pa shin tu dka' ba 'dug /des na rang res shar tshod phul ba na/ /sgo rum zhes pa zhang gzhung skad yin la/ /de nyid bod kyi skad du brjod pa'i tshe/ /dam nyams sgrol ba'i khang pa zhes pa'am/ /dgra bgegs kun 'joms zhes pa'ang 'gyur snyam pas/ /'di kha yin min kun gyis thugs rtog mdzod/ /min pa'i mtha' chod khung thub rang bzo dang / /bral ba de 'dra 'dug na thugs rjes bzung / /de nas sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po de'i/ /sku tshe'i stod thub chos skyong 'di nyid kyi/ /bzhugs lugs sngar gyi yon po de kha las/ /sus kyang bzos bcos ma nus de khar bzhugs/ /de rjes sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po de'i/ /mnal dang 'od gsal 'dres pa'i snang ba la/ /da ni nga la bcos kha byed ran 'dug /'di khar ma bzhag shin tu 'drongs par 'chos/ /de skad zer ba byung ma thag tu ni/

/sang nyin sgo rum gzim spyil dkar po ru/ /legs por phebs nas gzigs rtog mdzad pa'i tshe/ /phyag gi 'khrul sogs thams cad bral ba dang / /snyan shal g.yon la chag grum cung zad tsam/ /byung ba la sogs zhig gsos 'bul dgos pa/ /mang dag 'dug pas chos skyong rang nyid kyis/ /mngon sum du ni zhabs bskul phul bar dgongs/ /de ma khad la zhag bdun ljags bsnyen gyi/ /kha gso mdzad rjes rje btsun nyid rang gis/ /phyag rnams legs par bsil rjes dri bzang dang / /bla ma gong ma'i dam rdzas ril bu dang / /rten 'dam dpe grags la sogs byin rlabs kyi/ /phung pa ma lus thams cad gzungs chu dang / /bsgrub chu rnams la legs par sbrus byas te/ /sngags 'chang chen po nyid kyis phyag bzo mdzad/ /zhig gso'i rigs rnams legs par grub pa'i rjes/ /phyag gi 'khrul sogs kun la gzigs pa'i tshe/ /thams cad bral nas lhu lag ma 'grig par/ /da ni ci drag snyam du legs dgongs te/ /dar skud la sogs sgrog chas mtha' dag gis/ /gang la ci 'tshams 'chos par mdzad pa yis/ /bar skabs zhig la khrog sgra chen po zhig /byung bas phyag g.yog thams cad ha las nas/ /mgon khang phyi ru thams cad bros par gyur/ /rje btsun nyid la g.yo 'gul mi mnga' bar/ /de khar bzhugs pas ye shes mgon po yi/ /phyag gnyis sprug cing thugs khar steng 'og tu/ /ma bsgrigs rang 'grig byung ba mngon sum gzigs/ /e ma ngo mtshar de 'dra byung ngo zhes/ /bka' tshig rdo rje'i gsung mchog stsal ba thos/ /de tsam thos pa'ang rang re bsod nams che/ /mgon po dngos kyis mahā kā la yi/ /sku 'bag bsrong bar mdzad tshul de ltar yin/ /gzhan yang bka' drin mnyam med de nyid la/ /gsung byon bsu skyel mdzad pa la sogs pa/ /ngo mtshar mang du yod kyang re zhig bzhag /de nas sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po de/ /bde bar ma gshegs bar du sku 'bag nyid/ /shin tu 'drongs par lo grangs du mar bzhugs/

/der rjes sprel lo bde bar gshegs pa'i rjes/ /dus ngan sde 'khrug sna tshogs byung ba'i dus/ /dam tshig gtsang btsog skye bo du ma zhig /gdan sa chen po brgyud de dmag la song / /de dag song rjes sku 'bag de nyid ni/ /mdun du bub nas gtor sgam chen mo la/ /dbu btsugs zhal kyang nub phyogs 'gyur nas 'dug /thams cad ha las ci bya rtol med gyur/ /de skabs rang re dus 'khrug de nyid la/ /phan du re nas gam par sleb skabs su/ /sngags 'chang chen po grags pa blo gros kyis/ /bka' yi gsung shog pho nya dang bcas pa/ /legs par 'byor ste sku 'bag 'chus 'dug pas/ /'di nyid 'chos par myur du yongs dgos pa'i/ /bka' nan byung 'phral pho nya kho rang ni/ /ring par brdzangs te 'chos par gnang na 'gab/ /gal srid nges par bdag cag dgos 'dug na/ /zhag bdun bar du dra sgo yan chad la/ /su yang 'gro sa med pa'i dam bsgrags nyid/ /legs par gnang rjes sku ngos gcig pu yis/ /'khon 'jug sbyong ba'i gzungs bzlas gang 'gro dang / /bskang bshags dmigs su gang 'gro gnang ba zhu/ /bdag kyang zhag bdun gong du sleb yong lags/ /de skad zhu shog rten ldan dang bcas phul/ /pho nyas sleb rjes spangs bzhes gnang 'dug pas/ /de yi nus pas cung zad sgyed tsam byung / /zhag bdun nyin bar rang cag sleb ma thag /blta bar phyin pas shin tu 'chus che ba/ /kun gyis blta bar mi nus 'jigs dngangs che/ /de nas bdag gi zhag 'ga' bskang bshags phul/ /bzlas pa dag gis thugs rgyud gang 'khul byas/ /de nas nged rang sku mched gnyis ka yis/ /phyag len gnang rgyu yin yang de yi nyin/ /sngags 'chang chen po grags pa blo gros la/ /glo bur thugs brel byung nas phebs ma thub/ /nged rang da lta yong ngo khyed rang gis/ /legs par 'chos cig gsung ba'i bka' lung byung / /de nas nged rang dkon gnyer grogs mchog gsum/ /de kha ma gtogs mi ni su yang med/

/rang re gsum gyi dbang pos gang lcogs nyid/ /byed par brtsams te thog mar snyan dar rnams/ /rims kyis zhus nas grogs mchog dam pa yis/ /'di rnams bdag gi legs par bsgrigs yong gi /zer nas steng gi nyi mthong de ru song / /dkon gnyer ye shes zer ba de nyid ni/ /bdag gis zhun mar spar nas gzigs 'bul zhu/ /de skad zer zhing zhun mar ston du bcug /sku 'bag chen po la ni rang nyid las/ /gzhan pas grogs ni gcig kyang med na yang / /bla mar gsol btab rang 'dod 'phri ba spangs/ /chos skyong nyid la'ang bden brdar brjod pa'i rjes/ /sku rgyab phyin nas sku dpung gnyis po la/ /lag pa rgyab pas khrog sgra dang bcas pas/ /sku ni shin tu 'drongs par bslangs pa na/ /zhal gyi 'khrul thag ring du song 'dug ste/ /mgon po'i zhal nyid dang gi byung ba dang / /khrog sgra byung bas dkon gnyer ha las nas/ /zhun mar der brdab kho rang skad cig la/ /bla brang shar gyi ltag gi chos khrir bros/ /de nas ja sbyor gcig gi ring tsam la/ /nged rang lha mi gnyis po ma gtogs pa/ /su yang 'khor mkhan ma byung rang re la/ /chos skyong btang na chos skyong 'gyel gyi dogs/ /mi gtong du ni mthong sa gcig kyang med/ /bos kyang tshor sar su yang ma byung bas/ /da ni mi mthong ba la bcos gyur kyang / /brtan gling khel bar yong ba ga la srid/ /snyam nas lag pa g.yas kyis chos skyong zin/ /g.yon pas thob ched sbar nom rgyab pa na/ /gos chen nag po kha gang brnyed byung ba/ /de yi chos skyong sku nyid thog la bsgrags/ /de nas dkon gnyer 'tshol du phyin pa na/ /khong ni dbugs kyang dngangs shing 'dar thug byed/ /bdag gis gad mo rgad cing 'di 'dra'i mi/ /zhun mar mi ston nyi sbug dro sa 'dir/ /nyi ma lde ba khyod kyis dran pa ang / /mi ngan khyod 'dra'i grogs po byung bas lan/ /bsam lhag can khyod da ni rogs la 'gro/

/zhun mar spor cig da ni hur thag gyis/ /nyams dga' dang bcas de skad gleng ba na/ /khong ni bdag la lab lan 'di ltar byed/ /gzhan ma khyed rang bka' lung gang gnang yin/ /sku 'bag 'chos sar nga ni 'gro ri shi/ /da gi'ang sdug srog gcig ni chad pa yod/ /a ma de 'dra'i dred par su 'gro ba/ /mgon pos zhal gdangs spyan gsum hrig hrig byed/ /khyod ras ma mthong sku rgyab bsdad pas lan/ /de skad zer nas cig kyang 'gro ma phod/ /'o na khyod rang steng nas zhun mar spor/ /nga yi grogs mchog 'bod par phyin gyi byas/ /zhun mar 'khyer nas nged rang gnyis pos phyin/ /chos skyong sku ni shin tu 'drongs par byung / /zhal ni gdangs kha che bar 'dug pa las/ /grogs mchog nyid kyang skrag pa'i rnam pa dang / /bcas te ye shes pa khong bden nges shes/ /'di 'dra kun gyis mthong na ha las 'gyur/ /de skad zer zhing zhun mar legs par bstan/ /bdag gi 'chos dgos thams cad legs par bcos/ /de nas bskang gso brgya tshar la sogs pa/ /gtang rag rgyas par phul te legs par bzhugs/ /de nas re zhig song tshe nged rang gis/ /sgo rum ye shes mgon po'i sku 'bag drung / /dogs pa yod pa'i rten mjal byed mi 'ga'/ /byung ba de dag rnams kyi gnas bshad la/ /ngos la rgyug ces rgyan drung bka' gnang tshe/ /de rnams 'khrid nas phyin te legs par bstan/ /sngags mdud cig kyang byin cig gsung ba bzhin/ /ster rtsis byas nas snyan dar gcig zhus pas/ /sku de 'phar ba lta bu gcig byung bas/ /rang re'i blo la bzod rlag med pa yi/ /'jigs shing ya nga'i snang ba chen po byung / /de ma thag par rgyan drung nyid la zhus/ /sang nyin lta bu zhig la gzigs rtog ni/ /mi gnang kha med 'dug go thugs rtsol gnang / /de skad zhus pas sang nyin nged rang dang / /khyod rang gnyis ka phyin nas bltas pa drag /gsungs pa bzhin du gzigs rtog mdzad pa na/

/mgon po bzhugs sa'i 'og gzhi'i thog de nyid/ /legs par phug ste gnyan ston 'byor chen gyis/ /blta bar phyin pas sku 'bag bzhugs sa'i dbus/ /de na lho lcam shin tu ngan pa la/ /gas grum dum pa yod pa chag la khad/ /de nyid gcig pu ma gtogs brten byed kyi/ /rigs su gyur pa cung zad med nges pas/ /de yi mod la thams cad ha las gyur/ /mgon po rang gi thugs rje ma gtogs pa/ /'di 'dra sdibs na ci 'dra byed snyam pa'i/ /thams cad bla ma chos skyong dbyer med la/ /mos gus snying gi dkyil nas skyes par gyur/ /de nas dam tshig ldan pa'i gnyan ston dang / /grogs mchog gnyis kyi chos skyong bzhugs sa'i 'og /chu rdo che ba zhe cig dag gis bkang / /bsra zhing mthas pa brag ri lta bur bcos/ /de nas nged rang spun gyi sku 'bag nyid/ /legs par bcos te da lta'i bar du bzhugs/ /de yang chos skyong rang gi bskul ma nyid/ /yin par nges shes 'drong ngo skal ldan kun/ /de yang ma zad chos skyong 'di nyid ni/ /gur gyi mgon po dngos dang khyad med pas/ /'di la mthong snang mi cig so sor 'ong / /dam nyams la las gcig kyang mi mthong zhing / /la la dag gis sha za khrag 'thung mthong / /'ga' zhig gis ni gri gug 'phyar ba'ang mthong / /dam nyams la las mthong ma thag tu ni/ /sna khrag rgyab nas tshe yi dus byed 'byung / /gzhan ma skye bo phal cher thams cad la'ang / /la las snum dang la las skya ba dang / /la las zhal gdangs la las zhal 'dzum dang / /la las zhi zhing la las khro ba sogs/ /kun gyis mthun par 'di 'dra 'dug ces pa/ /so so skye bos kha tshon ga nas chod/ /dper na rang re gcig pu'i mthong snang la'ang / /lo bdun lon tshe sngags 'chang chen po yi/ /phyag phyir phyin nas thog mar mjal ba'i tshe/ /khyi gdong 'jigs rung rnga ral chen po yi/ /rtse mo nam mkha'i dbyings su bsnyogs pa tsam/ /phyag g.yas ral gri g.yon pa ban+dha gnyis/

/thugs khar steng 'og mdzad nas bsnams pa la/ /gsol phod sngon po rdo rje gsang lam ma/ /sku sham dkar po zhabs chag bsnams pa ste/ /mdor na sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po de/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku mtshams mdzad dus kyi/ /sku chas bzhes pa ngo mtshar ji bzhin las/ /gzhan ni gcig kyang mthong rgyu ma byung na'ang / /de dus na so gzhon pas zhu ma nus/ /de nas re zhig tsam nas zhus pa'i tshe/ /bla ma mgon po dbyer med mthong ba yin/ /lod rgyu med de phal cher drag po yi/ /sku ru bstan pas mngon spyod las kun 'grub/ /de skad gsungs pas rang nyid las nyon gyis/ /sgrib pa ma gtogs mgon po logs na med/ /bka' drin mnyam med 'di kha mgon po yin/ /snyam pa'i nges shes snying gi dkyil nas skyes/ /de ni mthong snang dang po byung tshul yin/ /de nas lo ni re zhig song ba'i tshe/ /rang lo nyer gsum lon pa'i dus tshod der/ /ye shes mgon po mjal bar phyin pa na/ /bzhugs sa de yang sngar bas yang du song / /sku mdog dag ni gser shog legs po la/ /spra rtsi rgya rtsi btang 'dra'i kha bsgyur ba'i/ /gser gyi thig le du ma yod pa la/ /'od zer 'bum phrag 'phro ba mngon sum mthong / /de tshe 'di ni bse 'bag ma yin pa/ /gser 'bag zer ba'ang bden nyen che ba 'dra/ /snyam pa'i rnam rtog skyes pa'ang byung nges yin/ /don gyi gser 'bag zer ba ga la bden/ /de 'dra mthong dus der yod grogs mched la/ /khyed tshor mthong snang ga 'dra 'dug ces dris/ /rang re'i mthong snang su la'ang ma smras so/ /de nyid mthong dus sems snang bde bar byung / /de la rtags na rgyas pa'i las 'grub pa'i/ /rten 'brel yin te mthong snang gnyis pa'o/ /de nas sku 'bag 'gul ba'i dus tshod der/ /sku mdog dkar zhing snum pa bdud rtsi 'dzag /zil pa khrom khrom byed pa'ang mngon sum mthong / /'dis ni zhi ba'i las nyid 'grub bam snyam/

/'di ni mthong snang gsum pa yin no dgongs/ /de nas mthong snang bzhi pa 'di nyid ni/ /dus gnas kun tu dmar smug nag shas che/ /de la skabs re dmar zhing skabs re nag /shin tu snum bag chags pa rgyun du mthong / /de ni dbang drag gnyis ka 'grub pa yi/ /rten 'brel yin te las bzhi thams cad kyi/ /dngos grub thob pa'i ltas su shes par byas/ /'di yang sngags 'chang chen po'i bka' drin las/ /gzhan pas dngos grub yin snyam skad cig med/ /snyoms las can gyi gang zag bdag 'dra la'ang / /mthong snang de 'dra byung ngo skal ldan rnams/ /rang re kha brdar byas pa ma gtogs pa/ /gzhan la'ang mthong snang bzang po ji snyed cig /yong gi los yod dges pa bskyed par mdzod/ /'di ni sku yi bka' babs dang po yin/ /de dang mthun par chos kyi bka' babs ni/ /tshogs bdag bka' stod gshin rje ltar bsgrub pa'i/ /rkyang sgrub sbags sgrub rjes gnang dbang khrid sogs/ /las tshogs rab 'byams ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /rje btsun mal lo blo gros grags pa las/ /legs par brgyud de sa chen nyid la babs/ /'di ni chos kyi bka' babs dang po yin/ /de 'dra'i sku 'bag yid bzhin nor bu de/ /sku yi rten du legs par gnang ba yin/ /de nas gsung gi rten du dar nag la/ /rtsa sngags bris dang thugs kyi rten mchog tu/ /lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu gnang ba gnyis/ /sku 'bag g.yon gyi phyogs na legs bzhugs pa'i/ /sgam nag khams gsum zil gnon zhes byar bzhugs/ /der yang ma zad gzhan yang 'di nang na/ /'khon rog gong ma rnams kyi thugs kha nas/ /legs par spros pa'i lcags phur ji snyed dang / /phyag tsha gnang ba'i sku spar du ma dang / /gong ma'i thugs dam phyag dpe mang po dang / /khyad par rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs kyi/ /dkyil thang zhing khams la sogs bgrang yas dang / /'khon ston chen po dkon mchog rgyal po dang / /sa chen gnyis kyi thun mong na bza' ni/

/rgya ther dkar po ri mo yod pa la/ /sku drag 'byar ba'i byin rlabs ngo mtshar dang / /rje btsun rtse mo'i gar gos dkar po la/ /gser gyi rgyan gzhi ngo mtshar ldan pa dang / /rje btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi/ /gsol phod hor gos 'phying kha rgyan gzhi yi/ /dum bu byin rlabs gzi 'od 'bar ba dang / /dpal chen 'od po'i gar gos dmar po ste/ /hor gos ta hūm̐ kha dog mtshal kha la/ /ri mo ngo mtshar ji snyed yod pa dang / /bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇa chen dang / /'gro mgon 'phags pa'i na bza'i dum bu sogs/ /bla ma gong ma'i na bza' mang dag dang / /gzhan yang chos skyong 'di nyid phebs dus kyi/ /gdong dar khra bo snyan gong ut+pal dang / /gsol phod sngo nag gser gyi rgyal gzhi yi/ /dum bu shin tu rnying pa 'ga' re ste/ /'di nyid cung zad dud par btang pa na/ /gdon bgegs ma lus rtsad nas brlag par byed/ /de 'dra'i nus pa phun tshogs ldan pa dang / /khyad par rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi/ /bde mchog nag po pa yi dbang rdzas kyi/ /sher shing las grub rdo rje'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /bzo khyad thon cing shin tu ngo mtshar ba/ /kun gyi mig gi bdud rtsir mthong bzhin du/ /bdud sprul rigs ngan dge sbyong 'ga' zhig gis/ /gdan sa chen po'i dkar chag yin zhes pa'i/ /deb gog du ma bsdus pa'i nang nyid du/ /'di la'ang dam shing shub bcas zer ba 'dug /'di ni 'khrul pa las kyang yang 'khrul te/ /dam shing dang ni kha twāṃ ga gnyis po/ /ngo yang mi shes yig ngan 'bri ba 'khrul/ /de yi rgyu mtshan dam shing 'di nyid la/ /phyi nang gsang gsum byung ba'i phyi ma ni/ /bzo lugs byings rnams gaṇ+ḍi 'dra ba la/ /cung zad mi 'dra'i khyad par stod smad la/ /sbom phra nor bu la sogs rgyan pa yin/ /nang dang gsang ba'i dam shing 'di gnyis ni/ /sher shing la sogs man ngag nas bshad pa'i/ /rgyu yi rigs la smad ni phur gzugs te/

/stod kyi khyad par nang gi dam shing la/ /sgro mdongs gsum gyis legs par brgyan pa dang / /gsang ba la ni khro zhal rnam gsum ste/ /pho gdong gnyis dang mo gdong cig gis brgyan/ /de ltar yin te kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la ni/ /de dag gang yang med pa thams cad kyi/ /mthun snang grub phyin ham lab byed pa 'khrul/ /de ni dogs dpyod cung zad brjod pa yin/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la'ang rigs lnga la sogs pa/ /rnam grangs shin tu mang ba yod gyur cing / /sku gsum mtshon pa'i mi mgo gsum brtsegs la'ang / /skam rlon rid gsum byed pa'i lugs cig dang / /skam po gsum brtsegs byed dang rdo rje yis/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la mtshon par gyur na yang / /rdo rje phyed dang rdo rje rang po yi/ /dbye ba mi cig so sor byed pa sogs/ /bshad tshod du ma 'dug kyang re zhig bzhag /gzhan yang sgam nag chen mo de yi nang / /'khon ston chen po gong ma yab yum gyi/ /bzhes spyad gsol sder rdo yi yu skyer dang / /ka li phyag phreng la sogs sku chas kyi/ /dngos po phun sum tshogs pa ji snyed kyang / /byin rlabs gzi 'od 'bar ba dang bcas ste/ /sgam chen 'di nang bzhugs pa mu tra yis/ /legs par btab te 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /sgrib gnyis sbyang phyir 'di na bzhugs pa yin/ /'phrin las rten gyi bse yi ga 'u la'ang / /'chad lugs mi cig rnam grangs mang na yang / /bse yi ga'u 'phrin las rten ma yin/ /man ngag las tshogs rab 'byams shog ril rnams/ /'phrin las rten yin de yi snod la ni/ /bse yi ga 'u de nyid 'byung ba ste/ /de yi ming la man ngag be'u bum zer/ /de 'dra'i 'phrin las rten du gyur pa ni/ /sku 'bag yid bzhin nor bu 'di nyid kyi/ /bzhugs sa'i sa btegs gru bzhi 'di yi nang / /legs par bzhugs zhes sngags 'chang chen po'i gsung / /'khrul med yin no thugs kyi dkyil du zhog /de nas gtor sgam chen mo'i mdun nyid kyi/

/sa btegs gru bzhi yod pa 'di yi nang / /drag po'i hom khung gru gsum 'bar ba'i dbus/ /mdze thod kha sbyar yod pa de yi nang / /bla chen stag tsha'i snying nyid da lta'ang yod/ /'di la 'phros te stag tsha'i lo rgyus nyid/ /cung zad brjod na snga ris stod kyi cha/ /bdud sprul sngags nag bla chen stag tsha dang / /bon nag re ba 'dzu gur zhes bya gnyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan la shin tu gnag pas na/ /brtse ba chen po kun dga' snying po ste/ /'di nyid bzhugs na bstan pa cher dar bas/ /'di la bar chad mtho 'tshams byed snyam du/ /stag tsha'i slob ma khams kyi ldan ma nas/ /'ong pa'i ming la rdor rgyal zer ba cig /gser gyi bslad nas sa chen dkrong du btang / /des kyang khas blangs sa skyar 'ong pa'i tshe/ /de skabs brtse chen kun dga' snying po de/ /sgo rum gzim spyil dkar por bzhugs dus su/ /khams pa de yis mjal kha zhus pa na/ /de kha yong gsungs sku gzhogs btang nas ni/ /dri rtog legs par mdzad pas 'di skad zhu/ /bdag ni skye sa khams kyi ldan ma nas/ /stod kyi phyogs su lo 'ga' song ba'i tshe/ /bla chen khyed kyi snyan pa thos pa na/ /shin tu mos pas mjal du 'ong pa yin/ /da ni re zhig khyed kyi phyag phyi la/ /bsdad pas chog pa thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ /zer ba la sogs bslu tshig mang zhus pas/ /brtse chen de yis mkhyen bzhin gnang ba mdzad/ /de nas re zhig song ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /khams pa de yis legs par brtag pa na/ /sku yi g.yas g.yon la sogs thams cad du/ /rje btsun sku mched bzhi po bzhugs pa la/ /na bza' gcig gis bstum nas bzhugs pa mthong / /de tshe kho la log lta 'di ltar skyes/ /'jig rten grogs pa'i pha phad bsdod lugs nyid/ /'di 'dra byed pa bla ma ga la yin/ /chos pa tsam yang min pas 'di nyid ni/ /dkrong la dka' las med snyam shin tu 'khrul/ /de tshe brtse chen kun dga' snying po yi/

/ye shes gzigs pas legs par dgongs gyur te/ /khams pa 'di ru shog dang nged rang rnams/ /steng gi nyi ma ya gir 'gro dgos 'dug /gsungs nas dpon slob kun gyis steng du phebs/ /nyi grib mtshams la bla ma chen po'i bzhugs/ /khams pa la ni sku mdun bsdod cig gsungs/ /khyod la rnam rtog ngan pa med yong mchis/ /de skad gsungs pas khams pa rdor rgyal nyid/ /shin tu skrag cing de 'dra ga nas yod/ /zhus kyang lus sems rtsab rtsob nyid du gyur/ /de tshe brtse ba chen po de nyid kyis/ /gsang sngags pa yi rdo rje slob dpon la/ /log lta byed pa shin tu 'khrul pa yin/ /gsungs nas zhabs gnyis skyong bar mdzad pa'i tshe/ /khams pa de yi bla ma sa chen gyi/ /zhabs mthil gnyis la zhib tu bltas pa na/ /g.yas la dges rdor g.yon la bde mchog gi /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang bcas ma lus pa/ /bris pa las kyang ches gsal ngo mtshar ba/ /mthong ba'i mod la khams pa rdor rgyal nyid/ /shin tu dad de sngar byas log lta dang / /bla chen stag tsha'i ji ltar brdzangs lugs sogs/ /shin tu 'gyod pa dang bcas bshags pa phul/ /phyin chad mi byed bla ma khyed nyid kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig bsrung phyir du/ /lus ngag yid gsum gtong ba dam bca' phul/ /de nas yid dam drag pos yar log ste/ /bla chen stag tsha nyid kyi mdun sar sleb/ /sa chen dkrong ba'i brdzun lab byas rjes su/ /stag tsha de nyid mgo bo 'khor gyur te/ /rdor rgyal nyid la nye gnas nang ma bcol/ /bslab bya'i tshogs kyang 'di skad gleng bar byed/ /nga yi mal sa 'di la tho ma gtong / /phreng ba'i mdud pa 'di yang ma bshig cig /phreng ba 'di nyid shin tu gtsang dgos so/ /zer ba la sogs bslab bya mang byas kyang / /res 'ga' mal sa de nyid mgo mjug bsgyur/ /phreng ba'i mdud pa bshig nas spyod lam dor/ /de sogs rnam par mi 'tshams mang du byas/ /de dang mtshungs par re ba 'dzu gur la'ang /

/phreng ba mal stan sngar lugs byed pa bzhin/ /thabs 'phrul sna tshogs byas pas khong gnyis po'i/ /ngan sngags tshogs rnams shin tu 'khrugs par gyur/ /de skabs bla chen kun dga' snying po des/ /gdan sa chen po'i dus mdos 'dzugs par mdzad/ /dus mdos 'di la'ang 'chad lugs mang na yang / /sngon gyi dus su mahā kā la yi/ /thugs dam mdos kyi bskang ba mdzad rjes su/ /de nyid zor du 'phangs pa'i nus mthu las/ /dgra bgegs thams cad rtsad nas gcod pa yin/ /de yi phyir na dus mdos zer ba lags/ /de bzhin mahā kā la'i gtor sgrub dang / /bstod sgrub gnyis kyang mi cig 'di ltar yin/ /gtor sgrub zhes bya gtor ma sgrub pa la/ /zer ba yin te gong gi mdos bzhin no/ /bstod sgrub zhes bya bskang gso mi byed par/ /bstod pa de nyid legs par sgrub pa ste/ /sngon dus brtse ba chen po kun snying nas/ /dam pa kun dga' grags pa yan chad du/ /mdos chen kho na mdzad pa byung ba yin/ /bla ma bdag nyid chen po man chad nas/ /sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje yan chad du/ /gtor sgrub kho na mdzad pa'i phyag len byung / /der rjes sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po de/ /spyir gyi bstan pa yongs kyi srog shing yin/ /khyad par gdan sa chen po'i dus mdos sogs/ /mahā kā la'i chog sgrig mtha' dag la/ /gangs can ljongs 'dir 'di las ngo mtshar ba/ /cung zad tsam zhig bdag gis ma mthong ngo / /des na dus mdos chog sgrig 'di nyid ni/ /gtor bstod gnyis ka sgrub pa'i lugs yin te/ /de yi tshul ni 'khrul med dam pa yis/ /deb sgrig yid bzhin nor bur gzigs par zhu/ /de ni 'phros don tsam zhig brjod pa yin/ /nus mthu'i mnga' bdag kun dga' snying po des/ /chos skyong mthu rtsal can rnams bran bkol te/ /mngon spyod drag po'i las la bskul ba'i tshe/ /sngar gyi khams pa rdor rgyal rgyud bskul nas/ /bdud sprul sngags nag bla chen stag tsha dang /

/bon nag re ba 'dzu gur zhes bya la/ /slob tshogs du ma yod pa ji snyed rnams/ /khong gi thabs byas la la chos dbar dang / /la la bsod snyoms la la ston las sogs/ /phyogs phyogs 'gro ba'i thabs lam bsgrigs byas nas/ /sngags bon gnyis po mtshams la legs bcug ste/ /mtshams g.yog nged rang gcig pus byed do zhes/ /phyogs phyogs kun du khyab par bsgrags rjes su/ /zhag bcu'i bar du sngar bzhin btang snyoms byas/ /de nas zhag bcu de las brtson par byas/ /de nas zhag bcu snying dang 'dra bar byas/ /de ltar byas pas sngags bon gnyis po yang / /dam tshig can zhes shin tu rtsis thang che/ /de tshe mtshams khang de yi sgo phyi ru/ /sngar nas med pa'i g.yag rgod rog po zhig /spu sprugs byed cing rwa brdar la sogs pa/ /drag po'i spyod pa zil dang ldan pa byung / /gzhan yang bya nag khyi nag ce spyang sogs/ /chos skyong sprul pa du ma byung ba'i tshe/ /dam tshig ldan pa'i khams pa de nyid kyis/ /legs par bsam mno gtang bas chos skyong gis/ /bskul ma yin par shes te dus tshes grangs/ /nyi shu dgu yi sa srod sleb pa na/ /chos skyong rnams kyi nus mthu'i byin rlabs nyid/ /legs par zhugs te mtshon cha rnon po yis/ /bstan dgra gnyis po skad cig nyid la bskum/ /de ma thag tu ro gnyis g.yag rgod la/ legs par bkal cing skad cig nyid la bros/ mtshan gang gcig la nyin lam drug tsam chod/ /de nas sa skyar sleb ste bla chen la/ /ro gnyis phul nas lo rgyus zhib zhus pas/ /shin tu mnyes nas bya dga' chen po gnang / /tshe 'di nyid la phyag chen thob pa yi/ /gdams pa zab mos rgyud kun smin mdzad de/ /khams su byon pas grub thob chen po byung / /'di dang bde gshegs khams pa rdor rgyal gnyis/ /ming zur cig kyang ngo bo mi cig ste/ /phag gru'i mtshan la rdo rje rgyal mtshan zer/ /'di yi ming la rdo rje rgyal po zer/

/so so yin pas rang bzo ma byed cig /de nas bla chen kun snying de nyid kyis/ /sngags nag stag tsha'i snying phyung hom khung nang / /mdze thod kha sbyar nang bcug mngon spyod kyi/ /'phrin las ci bsam 'grub pa'i bka' bsgo mdzad/ /de la rten nas da lta'i bar du yang / /bsgral ba'i zhing bcur gyur pa'i bstan dgra la/ /shin tu myur bar tshar gcod dgos pa'i tshe/ /hom khung zhal phye dgug gzhug mdzad pa sogs/ /phyag len ma nyams dam tshig ldan pa yis/ /zur tsam mthong ste sngags 'chang chen po des/ /bstan pa'i dgra bo lha gnas la sogs la/ /dgug gzhug bden brdar mdzad pa la sogs pa/ /nged kyis mthong zhing phyag len zur tsam yang / /cung zad go ba 'di ni skal ba bzang / /de nas bla chen stag tsha de nyid kyi/ /phung po byings rnams rkyal gog nang bcug ste/ /sgo rum them pa'i 'og tu mnan pa mdzad/ /der yang ma zad re ba 'dzu gur gyi/ /phung po de nyid chos khri thang mo che'i/ /nub sgo'i 'khris kyi chu 'gram rtsa ba na/ /mchod rten tshul du legs par mnan pa mdzad/ /'di la bskor ba mi byed dam pa'i lugs/ /gal srid bskor na g.yon bskor byed par bshad/ /de dang mnyam du gur gyi mgon po yi/ /rtsa sngags bgrang zhing bha ya na sogs te/ /bzlog mnan gsang sngags ma lus 'dren par byed/ /de ni 'phros don cung zad brjod pa yin/ /spyir gyi sgo rum gzim spyil dkar po na/ /bstan srung gtso bo mahā kā la nyid/ /dngos su bzhugs pa 'di ni ngo mtshar che/ /de skad du yang dbang po'i nyer mtsho las/ /de nas mthu chen mgon po'i pho brang na/ /nag po chen po mngon sum 'gro shes zhes/ /khams gsum kun tu grags pa'i dpal yon can/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog gang de bdag gis bstod/ /kyai rdo rje dang bdag med mkha' 'gro'i gtso/ /lhan cig bde chen gar gyis rol ba las/ /sprul pa'i sras kyi thu bo nag po che/

/bstan srung kun gyi mnga' bdag khyod la bstod/ /bse gdong can sogs gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir/ /snying rjes khro bo'i 'bag tu sku bzhengs shing / /mthing nag drag po rngams pa'i zhal bgrad nas/ /zlum pa'i stabs kyi 'chams shing 'gro la 'dud/ /bde gshegs kun gyi ye shes gcig bsdus khyed/ /gangs can ro yi ljongs 'dir spyan drangs nas/ /yon tan kun 'dzin tshul khrims phung po des/ /lus can bde ba'i mal du 'khrid nas kyang / /zag med ting 'dzin ster mdzad de la gnang / /dus gsum mkhyen pa'i blo gros dkyil 'khor can/ /khams gsum grags pa'i 'od kyis khyab mdzad des/ /rgyal mtshan kun la rab dga'i dpal ster zhing / /byang chub snying po mchog brnyes brtse chen la/ /gnam lcags las grub rdo rje thugs kyi rten/ /dbang sngon las grub tan sngags gsung gi rten/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog khyed skur bcas pa ni/ /bka' bsgos zhal mchis dang bcas gnang nas kyang / /sa bdag klu dbang ser skya gnas sa 'dir/ /shākya'i bstan pa bsrung phyir spyan drangs te/ /ri rab lhun po ji srid gnas kyi bar/ /zhing 'dir rtag cing brtan par bzhugs la 'dud/ /stobs chen khro bo'i zhing khams mi zad pa/ /'jigs rung ha ha rgod pas mi bzod pa/ /'di nyid thos shing mthong na sred med kyi/ /bu yang ba spu gzing cing ya nga ba'i/ /drag po'i gnam lcags las grub rdo rje yis/ /brtsig pa gur dang ra ba bcas pa las/ /tsheg tsheg tsha tsha drag po 'phro ba yi/ /ye shes me phung 'bar ba'i klong chen ste/ /dpal mgon mahā kā la'i pho brang ni/ /rim dgu rim par phub pa'i rtse mo na/ /rab 'bar mtshon cha dus mtha'i me ltar du/ /phyogs kun lhab lhab g.yo ba'i ba dan tshogs/ /mig sman mdog can mtsho chen rlung dmar gyis/ /'ur 'ur bskyod pa'i sgra skad chen po 'di/ /rdo rje'i me char drag tu 'bab pa yi/ /nga ro 'brug stong shin tu sgrog pa'i mthus/

/bdud dang mthar byed 'khor yug ri bo yi/ /bas mtha'i mtha' ru gson pa bskrad nas kyang / /dngangs shing stabs nas brgyal zhing 'gyel ba yis/ /de dag nga rgyal khongs su chud byas nas/ /'gro ba gzhan la mi 'tshe rdugs nyid de/ /byin nas byams dang snying rje cher skyes mdzad/ /de yi slad du 'di nyid mthu ldan gyi/ /dpa' bo'i zhing khams las gzhan gzhan du ci/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs ba de dag ni/ /bka' babs dang po'i rgyas bshad brjod pa yin/ /de nas bka' babs gzhan rnams brjod pa ni/ /sku yi bka' babs gnyis pa 'di ltar lags/ /shing mgon yid bzhin nor bu 'di nyid yin/ /'di la shing mgon zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug bram ze mchog sred de'i/ /sku gdung bzhu la phul dus pur sol las/ /rang byon tshul du legs par byon pas na/ /shing mgon yid bzhin nor bu zhes pa 'am/ /sol ba'i mgon po byas kyang chog pa yin/ /'di ni spyir gyi khyad par 'phags pa dang / /sgos su drag po'i las la shin tu bsngags/ /de yi rgyu mtshan sngags 'chang chen po yis/ /hor bzlog gnang dus nam mkha'i mthong nyid la/ /goms pa bdun gyi bar du legs byon te/ /bstan dgra brlag par mdzad pa the tshom med/ /de phyir 'di ni byin rlabs shin tu che/ /'di ni sku yi bka' babs gnyis pa ste/ /'di dang mthun par lam 'bras dang 'brel ba'i/ /grub chen ga ya dha ra nas brgyud pa'i/ /mgon rkyang nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba ste/ /'di ni chos kyi bka' babs gnyis pa yin/ /shing mgon 'di ni pu hrang lo chung pa/ /grags 'byor shes rab zhes bya las brgyud de/ /brtse chen kun dga' snying po'i phyag tu babs/ /rjes gnang 'di ni zhang ston nyid las gsan/ /de nas sku yi bka' babs gsum pa ni/ /rdo mgon yid bzhin nor bu 'di nyid yin/ /'di la rdo mgon zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ /'phags pa'i yul gyi ma la ya yi ri/

/gnam lcags yod pa'i rtse mo de nyid du/ /gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje'i thugs rje las/ /legs par grub pa'i rang byon ngo mtshar can/ /yin pa'i phyir na rdo mgon zhes su grags/ /'di ni sku yi bka' babs gsum pa yin/ /'di dang mthun par chos kyi bka' babs ni/ /sgrub thabs brgya rtsa sogs nas 'byung ba yi/ /gur gyi mgon po dpa' rkyang rjes gnang yin/ /'di ni chos kyi bka' babs gsum pa'o/ /sku dang rjes gnang gnyis ka ba ri ba/ /lo tsā chen po rin chen grags nyid las/ /legs par brgyud de sa chen nyid la babs/ /'di ltar bka' babs dang po drug po 'di/ /sa chen nyid las gzhan du 'chad pa 'khrul/ /de nas sku yi bka' babs bzhi pa ni/ /bris mgon yid bzhin nor bu 'di nyid yin/ /'di la bris mgon zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ /'di yang bram ze mchog sred pur ras la/ /legs par bris pas bris mgon zhes su grags/ /'di ni sku yi bka' babs bzhi pa yin/ /'di dang mthun par chos kyi bka' babs ni/ /gsang bsgrub spu gri bskor gsum zhes bya ba/ /'di la rjes gnang yod med 'chad tshul gyi/ /rnam grangs shin tu mang ba 'dug na yang / /bka' gtad 'dra ba'i rjes gnang chung ngu yod/ /'di gnyis rgya gar kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta/ /shākya shrī bha dra zhes bya la/ /legs par brgyud de sa paṇa phyag tu babs/ /'di ni bka' babs bzhi pa yin par nges/ /spyir gyi gur mgon zhes pa'i sgra bshad ni/ /rdo rje gur gyi chos skyong mchog yin cing / /chos bzhin bsgrub pa rnams kyi skyabs mgon yin/ /rnal 'byor mthu rtsal can gyi grogs po ste/ /de skad yin phyir gur gyi mgon por grags/ /mgon po la ni bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / /hril gyi bsdu na rnam pa lnga ru 'dus/ /de yang sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang / /'phrin las mgon po zhes bya rnam lnga las/ /thog mar rnam par snang mdzad 'phros pa las/

/sku yi mgon po dkar po byung ba yin/ /snang ba mtha' yas shin tu khros pa las/ /gsung gi mgon po dmar po byung ba yin/ /mi bskyod rdo rje shin tu khros pa las/ /thugs kyi mgon nag po byung ba yin/ /rin chen 'byung ldan shin tu khros pa las/ /yon tan mgon po ser po byung ba yin/ /don yod grub pa shin tu khros pa las/ /'phrin las mgon po ljang khu byung ba yin/ /'di rnams gur gyi mgon po'i byung tshul yin/ /gur gyi mgon po'i las mgon 'di nyid la'ang / /nang gi las mkhan ber nag zangs gri can/ /phyi yi las mkhan gcer bu zangs gri can/ /gsang ba'i las mkhan pu tra lcam sring dang / /las kyi rjes gcod bran bdud yab yum ste/ /rnam pa bzhi las ber gcer bran bdud gsum/ /gzhan du 'byung bas 'dir ni ma spros so/ /gsang ba'i las mkhan pu tra chen po yi/ /lo rgyus 'di la rnam grangs mang na yang / /hril gyi bsdu na 'jig rten 'das ma 'das/ /gnyis su yod de 'das pa'i lo rgyus ni/ /mgon po lcam dral gnyis kyi thugs kha nas/ /yam̐ dang mam̐ spros gnod sbyin yab yum byung / /gnod sbyin yab yum gnyis kyi thugs kha nas/ /yab las tri gnyis yum las bh+yoḥrnams spros/ /de las pu tra lcam sring byung ba ste/ /'di ni lo rgyus zur tsam smos pa yin/ /zhib par kun gyi thun mong ma yin pas/ /re zhig bzhag ste skabs cig tshe na 'byung / /gnyis pa 'jig rten pa yi lo rgyus la'ang / /rnam pa gnyis kyi dang po 'di ltar yin/ /sngon gyi dus su rgya gar lho phyogs su/ /bram ze ming sring gsum du skyes gyur te/ /ri brag rnams su sgrub la brtson pa sogs/ /dge sbyor dag la snying rus byas pa na/ /yul de'i skye bo phal cher dad gyur te/ /brnyed bkur zhabs tog phun sum tshogs pa byas/ /de la brten nas yul der sngar yod pa'i/ /ban+de sngags pa la sogs mchod gnas rnams/

/brnyed bkur chung du song bas phrag dog ste/ /rang gi sbyin bdag pho mo kun bsdus nas/ /bram ze ming sring gsum po gsod pa yi/ /gros ngan bsham ste rtsa ru phyin nas ni/ /khyed cag gsum pos nged kyi sbyin bdag 'phrogs/ /da ni gsod pa'i dus la babs byas pas/ /ming sring gsum pos de 'dra ma byed byas/ /zhu ba yang yang phul yang nyan ma 'dod/ /nges par gsod pa'i las la zhugs pa na/ /ming po che ba'i smon lam 'di skad btab/ /nga nyid skye ba 'di nas 'phos rjes su/ /lho phyogs gshin rje kun gyi gtso bo mchog /gshin rje gsod byed bya bar skyes gyur cig /skyes nas khyed rnams nga yi gsod gyur cig /bsad nas khyed rnams nga yi bran gyur cig /de bzhin ming po chung bas 'di skad du/ /ral pa spyi 'ching bya bar skyes gyur cig /de bzhin a gces kyang ni 'di skad brjod/ /gser gyi spu gri bya ba skyes gyur cig /de skad brjod pas smon lam mtha' btsan zhing / /dge ba spyad pas bden tshig 'grub pa'i mthus/ /bsad ma thag tu smon lam ji bzhin skyes/ /skyes ma thag tu rang gi gshed ma rnams/ /thog mar bsad de bran du gyur pas na/ /bud med skyes pa dge slong sngags pa ste/ /ru 'dren sde bzhi 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan yang / /de ltar yin te rgyas par ma spros so/ /de nas lo rgyus gnyis pa 'di ltar ste/ /pu tra lcam sring gsum po de dag las/ /mon phrug ming sring gsum du sprul nas ni/ /grog po phu yi byang gi ri ldeb la/ /brag phug kha ni shar lhor bstan pa'i 'gag /snga dus snyug sdong chen po zhig kyang 'dug /de skad sngags 'chang chen po'i gsung las byung / /snyug ma de rnams pu tra'i rten rdzas kyi/ /tshigs dgu tshigs bdun la sogs yin nam snyam/ /mon phrug gsum pos nub po de ru bsdad/ /nyin bar chang tshangs na khar phyin nas ni/ /gro ma sgrug cing zas kyi sta gon la/

/nyin re bzhin du yang yang phyin pa na/ /de khar yod pa'i phyugs rdzi 'ga' zhig gis/ /gnod pa bskyal bas khong rnams tshig pa zos/ /de yi mod la rel rog lpags pa la/ /rkyal ba bzos te phus btab dbyug pas bsnun/ /ngan sngags bzlas pas gnod pa bskyel ba yi/ /phyugs rdzi dag ni phal cher shi bar gyur/ /de nas rje btsun kun dga' snying po yis/ /snyan du gsan nas mon phrug gsum po dag /'phral du nga yi mdun du bos la shog /khyed rnams kun gyis gnod pa ma byed cig /de skad gsungs nas khong rnams sku mdun byung / /phyag btsal pus btsugs gro ma sder gang phul/ /thal mo sbyar nas gus 'dud gnas pa la/ /brtse ba chen po'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ /khyed rnams gar yong gar gnas ga 'dra yin/ /sems can rnams la gnod 'tshe byed pa ci/ /legs par smos shig mon phrug ming sring gsum/ /de skad gsungs pas mon phrug ming sring tshos/ /zhu ba'i lan 'debs 'di ltar phul ba yin/ /bdag rnams rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul phyogs ste/ /lho yi phyogs nas legs par 'ong pa yin/ /'dug sa gdan sa'i shar gyi grog po yi/ /stod kyi brag phug ya ru nub mo bsdad/ /nyin bar kha zas 'tshol bar phyogs kun phyin/ /khyad par chang tshangs na khar phyin pa'i dus/ /phyugs rdzi rnams kyi ngag las 'di skad byung / /mtha' mi mon phrug ngan pa 'di kun zer/ /khu tshur bsnun zhing gro ma la sogs pa/ /chas kun 'phrogs te rgyun du gshe bar byed/ /de ltar byas dus bdag rnams tshig pa zos/ /rkyal chung phus 'debs byas pas khong rnams shi/ /nyes pa gang snang bla ma khyed la bshags/ /nged rnams 'di ru 'ong pa'i dgos pa ni/ /khyed kyi bstan pa bsrung du 'ong pa lags/ /de skad zhus pas brtse ba chen po yis/ /'o na de ltar legs so khyed rang rnams/ /rten pa'i dngos po ga 'dra zhig gis ni/ /gtor bsngo zhig kyang nged kyis byed pa yin/

/gzhan yang zas gos la sogs gang dgos rnams/ /legs par smos shig skal ldan mon pa tsho/ /de skad gsungs pas khong rnams 'di skad smra/ /gtor ma gnang ba cis kyang bka' drin che/ /gos lham gnang na thugs rjes bzung ba gda'/ /dngos po'i rigs spyad gzhan ni mi dgos la/ /bla ma'i chu ra mdzad pa'i zangs mo che/ /a long mang po khrog sgra 'byin byed pa/ /bstan dgra ma lus brlag par byed pa'i mtsho/ /khams gsum zil gnon 'di rnams bdag rnams zhu/ /de skad zhus pas brtse chen gsung nyid las/ /cis kyang yong ngo bstan pa bsrung bar byos/ /de skad gsungs ma thag tu skad cig la/ /mon phrug gsum po zangs chen de la thim/ /de nas gtor bsngo zhig kyang rtsoms par mdzad/ /gos lham sogs kyang chag med rgyun du gnang / /de 'dra'i zangs chen khams gsum zil gnon ni/ /da lta nang sor bzhugs pa 'di nyid yin/ /spyir gyi pu tra chen po 'di nyid la'ang / /phyi nang gsang gsum yod pa'i dang po ni/ /bram ze'i skabs dang mon chung pu tra yin/ /nang ni gshin rje gsod byed la sogs yin/ /gsang ba pu tra chen po 'di nyid ste/ /mdor bsdus tsam zhig 'di ru brjod pa yin/ /rgyas par dgos na mgon pod la sogs dang / /thun mong min pa'i gsang khrid rnams su gzigs/ /des na mon sgo grog ces brjod pa yi/ /sgra bshad 'di ltar yin no mkhyen ldan rnams/ /mon pa ming sring gsum po bsdod pa yi/ /brag phug chen po de yi sgo 'gram na/ /grog po yod pas mon sgo grog ces zer/ /de lta pu tra'i lo rgyus zur tsam zhig /brjod pa 'di ni gur gyi mgon po dang / /'brel chags yin pas cung zad brjod pa yin/ /de ltar chos skyong che ba gur mgon ste/ /chung ba gnyan mgon zhal bzhi yin pas na/ /'di yi lo rgyus zur tsam brjod pa la/ /thog mar gnyan lo chen po dar ma grags/ /de yi rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul mchog tu/

/bla ma chen po rat+na kirti dang / /rdo rje gdan pa sogs las dam pa'i chos/ /mang du gsan cing rig pa'i gnas kun la/ /mkhyen rab phul du phyin te mkhas par grags/ /de nas bod du 'byon dus pan+dhe ba/ /rin chen grags pa nyid la gsang 'dus te/ /ye shes zhabs lugs dbang zhig gsol btab pas/ /ngas ni mi yong khar+sa pa ṇi yi/ /lho yi phyogs kyi ri sul nags gseb na/ /nga yi mched mo rnal 'byor dbang phyug ma/ /rje btsun ku sa li pa bya ba gcig /gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub pa mdzad kyis yod/ /de ru song la zhus shig khyed rang dang / /las kyi 'brel pa yod pas dbang bskur sogs/ /gdam ngag ma lus gnang ba 'dug gi gsungs/ /khar+sa pa ṇi lho phyogs zer ba yi/ /rgyu mtshan dge bsnyen zhi ba'i go cha des/ /ri bo po ta la nas spyan ras gzigs/ /khar+sa pa ṇi dngos su spyan drangs nas/ /de wi ko ṭa'i gnas mchog nyid na bzhugs/ /de yi lho yi ri sul yin pas na/ /khar+sa pa ṇi'i ri sul bya ba yin/ /de nas gnyan los bla ma pan+dhe bas/ /ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du nags sib der/ /legs par btsal bas shing sdong ngo mtshar ba/ /shin tu che ba zhig gi khog pa na/ /rnal 'byor ma ni dpon slob bzhi gda' skad/ /de yi nang nas g.yog gsum re mos kyis/ /grong 'dab phyin nas 'tsho ba legs par btsal/ /rnal 'byor ma ni sgrub pa mdzad kyi 'dug /de la gnyan los thugs la 'di snyam du/ /bla mas lung bstan yod pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ /yin min brtag phyir g.yog mo de rnams la/ /khyed rnams rnal 'byor ma ni yin nges na/ /nus pa zhig ni bdag la ston gsungs pas/ /gcig gi brang gshags khog pa'i nang de na/ /gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i/ /mar me shin tu gsal ba bstan pa'i tshe/ /nges shes skyes nas gtso mo de nyid la/ /phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul nas dbang zhus pas/ /khyod la su yi lung bstan gsungs pa na/ /bdag la bla ma pan+dhe ba yi bstan/

/de skad zhus pas rnal 'byor ma nyid kyi/ /nga la da lta 'jam pa'i rdo rje yis/ /gnang ba ma thob khyod rang bsdod khom na/ /lo gcig tsam nas dbang bskur bya 'o gsungs/ /de bzhin bgyid lags zhus pas thugs dges te/ /'o na khyod la mtha' 'khob mi ngan dang / /gcan gzan dug sbrul sogs kyis 'tshe ba 'ga'/ /byung dogs yod pas grong 'dab pha gi na/ /bram ze chen po mdog sngo mi rkang gi /gling bu bzung ba gcig yod de nyid la/ /grogs 'chol ci za ci 'thung phud nas byin/ /ci 'byor mchod dang brnyed bkur phun tshogs kyis/ /de bar bar chad cig kyang mi 'byung ba/ /nga yis byin gyis brlab bo gsungs nas gnang / /de bzhin byas pas lo gcig song ba'i tshe/ /rnal 'byor chen mo'i gsung las 'di skad byung / /da ni nga yi lhag pa'i lha mchog la/ /gnang ba thob pas dbang bskur bya dgos na/ /tshogs kyi yo byad tshang bar bshom cig gsungs/ /ji ltar gsungs bzhin gnyan lo chen po des/ /gser zho gsum la sha chang spos la sogs/ /yo byad phun sum tshogs pa kun bsgrub rjes/ /de rnams 'khyer te rnal 'byor chen mo yi/ /drung du phyin nas tshogs rdzas legs par phul/ /gdan yang mang po bsham rjes rnal 'byor ma'i/ /zhal nas mgron rnams spyan drongs gsungs pa na/ /bdag gis mi brnyed zhus pas kha sing gi /grogs po bram ze bos la spyan 'dren gyis/ /de ltar gleng pas bram ze'i skra seb nas/ /mi rkang gling bu phyung ste bus ma thag /phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad la sogs thams cad nas/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor pho mo dang / /zhing skyong bka' sdod sprin phung 'thib pa ltar/ /bsam mi khyab pa 'dus nas gral 'khod cing / /tshogs kyis mnyes par byas nas rten 'brel 'grig /dbang bskur yongs su rdzogs pa gnang rjes su/ /spyir gyi gdams pa rgya mtsho bsam mi khyab/ /legs par gsan cing khyad par 'phags pa ni/

/thun mong min pa'i gdams pa lnga yin te/ /gsang 'dus sbyor drug sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs dang / /uṇ+ṇi ṣa dang chos skyong 'di nyid kyi/ /gdams pa ma lus yongs su rdzogs par gnang / /khyad par chos skyong 'di yi rjes gnang dus/ /bram ze khyod kyis kho yi g.yog gyis shig /'phrin las rnam bzhi 'bad med bsgrub pa sogs/ /khong gis ci gsungs bsgo ba nyan dgos so/ /zhes sogs bka' bsgo rgyas par gnang ba ste/ /mi la mi nis sprod pa ji bzhin du/ /gnyer dam mdzad pa'i chos skyong de nyid ni/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bu 'di yin pas/ /bsgrub thag nye zhing byin rlabs che ba ste/ /kun gyi gtsug gi nor bu mchog yin no/ /de nas bla chen gnyan gyis rgya gar nas/ /bod du 'byon dus bram ze de nyid dang / /bal yul phan chad dngos su 'grogs shing byon/ /de tshun ban chung nye gnas tshul bzung nas/ /legs par byon cing pu hrang phebs pa'i tshe/ /mnga' bdag btsad lde zer ba'i sdig rgyal de/ /nga nyid rgyal po yin te snga ris kyi/ /stod na grags pa che zhing dbang stobs kyang / /nga rang che bas lo tsā dpon slob kyis/ /phyag 'tshal snyam du nga rgyal che bar yod/ /bla ma gnyan lo chen po de nyid kyi/ /thugs dgongs la ni nged rang rgya gar gyi/ /grub thob kun gyi slob ma lo tsā yin/ /khyad par rdo rje gdan pa rin chen grags/ /mar me mdzad bzang rnams kyi chos brgyud rnams/ /legs par 'dzin pa'i slob ma'i mchog yin pas/ /btsad pas nga la phyag dang sne len sogs/ /byed dam snyam nas tshong pa mang po dang / /mnyam du 'grogs nas byon pa'i dus tshod der/ /mnga' bdag btsad lde la ni rgya gar nas/ /phra ma byung ste gnyan lo zer ba 'dis/ /ngan sngags thams cad bslab nas song yod pas/ /rgyal po nyid la sha ma mi byed do/ /zer ba byung tshe rgyal po de nyid kyang / /dus chags che bas 'khrul nas bden rung snyam/

/blon po dpa' rtsal ldan pa'i rta pa ni/ /bcu phrag gsum btang bla ma dkrong bar byas/ /de tshe bla ma gnyan gyi mnal lam du/ /rgyal pos brdzangs pa'i blon po gdug pa can/ /de dag yod par mkhyen te tshong pa la/ /phye phud bsdus shig nged rang 'di kun la/ /bar chad cig ni 'ong bar 'dug pas na/ /chos skyong chen por gtor ma 'bul dgos 'dug /gsungs nas gtor ma'i rgyu la spos 'bru sman/ /bdud rtsi la sogs btab nas phul rjes su/ /zhing skyong chen po tsa turmu kha la/ /gsol ba btab cing 'di yi sngags bzlas pa/ /tsam gyi tshong pa rnams kyi mthong snang la/ /mon pa sngon po lnga ni gar byed cing / /gnyis ni bro brdung gnyis ni gri skor byed/ /jo mo zhwa theb can gcig dngos su mthong / /de yi mtha' bskor bka' skyong mang po dang / /rlung nag 'tshub mas legs par bskor ba'i dbus/ /bla ma dpon slob bcug nas byon pa na/ /blon po gdug can rnams kyi mthong snang la/ /rlung nag 'tshub ma'i gseb na a tsa ra/ /gri bskor byed pa gnyis zhig ma gtogs pa/ /gzhan ni gcig kyang ma mthong 'u thug ste/ /phyir log 'ong pas bla ma dpon slob rnams/ /legs par phebs grub 'dug pas ngo mtshar ste/ /lo rgyus ci zhib rgyal por zhus pa'i tshe/ /mnga' bdag rgyal po de yi bsam pa la'ang / /bla ma 'di ni chos skyong chen po rnams/ /bran du 'khol ba'i nus pa can zhig 'dug /snyam te 'gyod pa skyes nas babs bshags phul/ /zhabs gnyis spyi bor blangs nas bla ma yi/ /bka' bzhin bsgrub pa dam bca' brtan po nyid/ /snying nas byas pas rgyal po de nyid rang / /ma grong tsam zhig byung bar gyur na yang / /mnga' thang kha rje phun tshogs ma lus pa/ /skad cig nyid la thams cad nub par gyur/ /gdug pa can gyi blon po de dag rnams/ /la la brgyal zhing smyo 'bog rengs pa dang / /kun gyi kha nas khrag skyugs 'o dod 'bod/ /bzod klag med pa'i sdug bsngal drag po dang /

/bcas te thams cad tshe yi dus su byas/ /de la brten nas bla chen gnyan lo la/ /chos skyong bran du 'khol ba'i snyan pa dang / /chos skyong nyid la'ang mthu rtsal myur ba yi/ /snyan pa'i grags pas sa steng khyab par gyur/ /de nas rim gyis phebs par mdzad pa'i tshe/ /gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i phu/ /kha 'ub bskyed lhas zhes bya'i brag ri la/ /gnyan mgon gtsug lag khang bzhengs phyag nas nyid/ /mdzad dus chos skyong 'di la bka' gtad pas/ /gtsug lag khang la me chen dngos su 'bar/ /de phyir mgon khang de yi ming la yang / /me 'bar gtsug lag khang zhes yongs su grags/ /de nas gnyan lo chen po de nyid kyi/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug gnam chen kha'ub pa/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya'i bla chen la/ /chos skyong 'di yi rjes gnang gdam ngag dang / /las tshogs rab 'byams mtha' dag gnang ba la/ /rten nas mdun ri'i ngos la bon po yi/ /grong khyer mang po yod pa de dag dang / /dus gnas kun tu 'gras shing 'tshe ba la/ /mthu gtad mdzad pas gnam lo gcig nyid kyi/ /khongs su bon po pho mo brgya tsam shi /thog chen bco brgyad phab nas grong khyer rnams/ /skad cig nyid la thams cad brlag par mdzad/ /de yang chos skyong 'di yi mthu rtsal dang / /bla ma chen po'i grub rtags ngo mtshar ba/ /gnyis ka yin no kun gyi dgongs pa mdzod/ /de rjes gnyan los dar lung gnyan sogs su/ /'gro phan mdzad cing rgyun ring bzhugs par mdzad/ /skabs cig dus su chos skyong rnam sprul gyi/ /ban chung de la gnyan los 'di skad gsungs/ /da ni lo yang mang rab lon pa dang / /nga ni mya ngan 'da' ba'i dus la babs/ /des na khyed rang kha 'ub brag rdzong na/ /nged kyi bu yi mchog gyur kha 'ub pa/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya bzhugs yod pas/ /der song nga la ji ltar byed pa bzhin/ /khong gi phyag g.yog tshul bzhin bsgrub par gyis/ /khong nyid mya ngan 'das par gyur pa na/

/khyed rang rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gshegs cig /de skad gsungs te gnyan lo mya ngan 'das/ /der rjes chos skyong sprul pa de nyid kyis/ /sku gdung bzhugs pa'i sa 'bum byin rlabs kyi/ /gzi 'od 'bar ba de nyid bzhengs pa sogs/ /rjes kyi bya ba mtha' dag bsgrub rjes su/ /bla ma gnyan gyi bka' bzhin skyed lhas su/ /legs par byon cing gnam gyi nye gnas mdzad/ /de tshe grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po des/ /ban chung de la thugs rtog mdzad pa'i tshe/ /phal pa min pa'i rdzu 'phrul brtul shugs 'ga'/ /yang yang ston pa gzigs te the tshom zos/ /'di ni khyad par 'phags pa'i sprul pa zhig /yin par nges te thabs lam sna tshogs kyis/ /rang gzugs ston par re ba'i thugs bsam zhig /yod pa'i dus su zhing skyong chen po nyid/ /bod yul kha ba can 'dir bstan srung la/ /bzhugs pa'i rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i mthus/ /nyin gcig kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa nyid/ /shin tu che ba babs pa'i dus tshod der/ /ban chu de yi gsol chu 'chu bar byon/ /skyogs nyid bsnyel ba'i tshul bstan chu 'gram bzhag /chu nyid bsnams nas sgrub khang rtser byon te/ /'jam nyid skol bar brtsams pas skyogs med de/ /g.yas g.yon sogs su legs par gzigs pa'i tshe/ /skyogs nyid chu 'gram lus pa thugs dran gsos/ /de dus bla chen gnam gyi gzim phug nas/ /legs par sgrim te gzigs par mdzad pa'i tshe/ /chos skyong sprul pa ban chung nye gnas des/ /gsol thab yod pa'i 'khris kyi dkar sangs nas/ /phyag ring brkyangs te skyogs nyid blangs pa'i tshe/ /bla chen gnam gyi sgrub khang nas bzhengs te/ /ban chung de'i phyag la 'chang nas ni/ /khyed ni spyir gyi gzhan las rtsal che zhing / /rdzu 'phrul du ma ston par 'dug pa dang / /khyad par da lam chu skyogs len lugs kyi/ /rdzu 'phrul de 'dra ngo mtshar che bas na/ /khyed nyid sprul par yin pa the tshom med/

/sku nyid dngos su ston pa cis kyang 'tshal/ /zhes sogs gsol ba 'debs par mdzad pa na/ /bla ma chen po de skad mi gsungs zhu/ /nged rang gnyis la mi legs gsungs pa la/ /slar yang gsol ba drag tu btab pa'i tshe/ /bla ma nga nyid dam tshig bsrung du chug /sngon gyi dus su ri sul rnal 'byor ma'i/ /bka' bzhin gnyan gyi phyag phyi byas pa yin/ /gnyan gyi bka' bzhin khyed rang nam gshegs bar/ /phyag phyi byas nas rgya gar 'gro ru chug /gsungs kyang grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po des/ /dbu tshugs chen po'i nan tan gsol btab pas/ /'o na bla ma nyid rang skrag pa yi/ /snang ba cung zad tsam yang ma skyes par/ /mdzod cig gsungs nas kha'ub brag rdzong gi /dbu ni nam mkha'i mthongs su sleb pa dang / /zhabs gnyis srin brag gong 'og gtad par mdzad/ /phyag bzhi nam mkha'i khams rnams khyab pa dang / /bcas te bsgrub pa'i dus kyi mgon po ste/ /zhal khra can nyid yongs su rdzogs par bstan/ /chos skyong de nyid shin tu zil che bas/ /bla ma bde stong ngang du cung zad gyur/ /de las sangs te legs par gzigs pa na/ /chos skyong de nyid 'od zer 'phro bar bzhugs/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang thugs kyi 'phrin las las/ /zhes sogs bstod pa zhig kyang rtsom par mdzad/ /legs par gzigs pas shangs mtshal cung zhig kyang / /byung ba de nyid sku phyis ras gcig la/ /phyag bris mdzad de gtso 'khor lnga po rnams/ /legs par grub bstun sprul pa'i sku de nyid/ /'ja' tshon 'od zer me phung 'bar ba yis/ /tshul gyi brag sgo nyid la legs par thim/ /de nas chos skyong 'di nyid gnyan grags pas/ /'tshub 'gyur che ba'i rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs dang / /khyad par rta nag khyi nag la sogs pa/ /skad cig nyid la 'khrid par mdzad pa dang / /skyed lhas mdun gyi rgya lam de nyid la'ang / /'gro 'dug byed pa'i skye bo thams cad kyis/ /phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul gus 'dud byed pa sogs/

/ma byas tshe na tshar gcod 'byung ba dang / /khyad par dam tshig nyams pa'i skye bo rnams/ /lung pa de ru yong pa lta ci smos/ /mgon khang thug chen la sogs rgyang ring nas/ /mthong ba tsam gyi mod la khrag skyugs te/ /tshe yi dus byed gyur pa mang dag byung / /de sogs chos skyong 'di nyid gnyan pa yi/ /grags pa chen pos sa steng khyab par gyur/ /de sogs rgyas bshad mang dag yod na yang / /yi ge mang gyi dogs pas re zhig bzhag /'di ni gong du chos skyong gnyis 'byung ba'i/ /rgyu mtshan 'brel chags yin pas brjod pa yin/ /de ltar jo bo chen po'i gzigs snang gi /hrīḥyig khar+sa pa ṇi byung tshul rnams/ /brtse chen kun dga' snying po'i rnam thar dang / /legs par bstun te rags rims brjod zin nas/ /da ni gong gi 'jam dbyangs bdun brgyud rnams/ /legs par 'byung bas thugs gzhig mdzad 'tshal lo/ /spyir gyi 'jam dbyangs bdun brgyud 'di nyid la/ /mi 'dra ba yi khyad par mang na yang / /'dir ni brtse chen kun dga' snying po de'i/ /'jam dpal 'grub dus de yi thugs kha nas/ /shes rab ral gri mu 'brel bdun byung ba/ /de dang mtshungs par zhal ngo bdun brgyud ni/ /bar ma chad par 'byung ste 'di ltar yin/ /kun 'bar rtse mo grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / /dpal chen 'od po sa paṇa zangs tsha'i mtshan/ /'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa ste/ /'di bdun 'khrul med yin no phyag rdor gyi/ /sprul pa 'gro mgon phyag na yin par nges/ /sngags 'chang chen po'i gsung las de ltar byung / /de yi rgyu mtshan kun mkhyen chen po yi/ /thugs rje'i gter chen la sogs gsungs pas so/ /de ltar bdun gyi 'jam dbyangs dang po ste/ /gcen po kun dga' 'bar zhes bya ba ni/ /tshwa mo rong pa jo lcam phur mo la/ /legs par 'khrungs te ma ga dha ru byon/ /dam pa'i chos la sbyangs pa mthar phyin mdzad/ /rig pa'i gnas lnga kun la mkhas par grags/

/bod du 'byon par dgongs pa gtad pa'i tshe/ /tshad pas snyung ste dgung lo nyer gnyis la/ /bde ba can gyi zhing du gshegs par gyur/ /de nas 'jam dbyangs gnyis pa bsod rtse ni/ /tshwa mo rong ma jo lcam 'od sgron te/ /'di gnyis sku mched yin te 'di bgres so/ /yab ni dgung lo nga gcig bzhes pa'i dus/ /chu pho khyi lor ngo mtshar du ma yi/ /bltas dang bcas te 'di nyid sku 'khrungs so/ /'khrungs ma thag nas sku skye dran pa dang / /mi thub zla ba yin par zhal gyis bzhes/ /'od gsal ting 'dzin du mar mnyam gzhag cing / /kho bo nyid ni byis pa'i spyod pa las/ /nges par 'das zhes yang yang gsungs par mdzad/ /chos rnams phal cher bslab sbyang ma dgos par/ /phul du phyin te mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /'jam dbyangs byin rlabs de dang mtshungs par gyur/ /de nas dgung lo bcu drug bar du ni/ /yab la mnga' ba'i zab chos ma lus gsan/ /de yang thog mar yum la 'khrungs pa'i skabs/ /'phags yul rdo rje gdan gyi ya them la/ /'jam dbyangs sprul pa bsod nams rtse mo ni/ /rdo rje theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor gyi/ /dbang phyug dam pa sa skyar skyes zer ba'i/ /yi ge mkha' 'gro ma yis bris nas sbyar/ /de la rten nas snyan pa'i grags pas khyab/ /de nas dgung lo gsum nyid bzhes pa'i dus/ /'jam dpal kyai rdor sgrol ma mi g.yo ba/ /de la sogs te yi dam mtha' dag gi /zhal gzigs lung bstan phun sum tshogs pa brnyes/ /de nas dgung lo bcu bdun bzhes pa'i tshe/ /gcung la bstan pa gtad nas gsang phur byon/ /phya pa chos kyi seng ge zhes bya yis/ /thog drangs mkhas btsun ji snyed du ma rnams/ /legs par bsten nas rig pa'i gnas rnams la/ /sbyang tshul mdzad pas 'phags yul rgya gar gyi/ /chu bo gaṅga tshun chad 'di nyid la/ /'di bas mkhas pa med ces grags pa thob/ /de yi rgyu mtshan rje btsun chen po yi/ /rtse mo'i bstod pa khyod nyid dam pa mar/

/sngon gnas dran zhing byis pa'i spyod pa spangs/ /'dod lhas zhal bstan rgyud sde rgya mtsho yi/ /drang nges don la blo rgyas bcu bdun tshe/ /gaṅga tshun chad yongs su grags la 'dud/ /ces gsungs gzhan yang rje btsun de nyid ni/ /phya pa nyid la bu chen slob ma'i tshogs/ /ji snyed yod pa'i nang nas jo sras bzhi/ /mkhas par grags shing de bzhi'i nang nas kyang / /ches cher mkhas pa bsod nams rtse mo zhes/ /'dzam gling snyan pa'i grags pas khyab par gyur/ /de nas gdan sa chen por phebs pa'i tshe/ /gsung ngag rin chen lam dang 'bras bur bcas/ /gdams pa rgya mtsho ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /rje btsun chen pos gtso mdzad skal ldan la/ /legs par gnang ba'i chos grwa chen po ni/ /bla brang shar gyi steng gi gtsug lag khang / /'di nyid yin te da lta ye rgan gyi/ /khang pa yin pa'i bshad tshod byed pa 'khrul/ /de 'dra'i bla brang khyad par 'phags pa der/ /tha skar zla ba'i dus bzang tshes gcig nyin/ /gsung ngag gnang dus skal ldan slob ma la/ /gzigs snang mi cig so sor byung ba ni/ /chos grwa de yi mdun gyi nam mkha' la/ /'ja' 'od gur dang mchod tshogs ji snyed dang / /khyad par 'phags pa de yi dbus zhig na/ /rje btsun chen pos 'jam dbyangs bzhugs pa gzigs/ /jo sras lcags kyi rdo rjes bir+wa pa/ /rmog ston gtsug tor dbon sogs phal cher gyis/ /spyan ras gzigs nyid dngos su mthong gyur te/ /skal ldan slob ma bcu dgu smin par mdzad/ /de yi rgyu mtshan rje btsun chen po yis/ /bsod nams rtse mo'i bstod par 'di skad gsungs/ /dus phyis gsung ngag ston tshe nam mkha' la/ /mchod sogs dbus na 'jam dpal bir+wa pa/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang mthong snang gsum bstan te/ /bcu dgu dag pa'i snang bar gyur la 'dud/ /de skad gsungs 'dug snying nas dad pa mdzod/ /gzhan yang nub kyi gnas chen mchog gyur pa/ /chu mig rdzing kha zer ba'i sa yi char/

/gtsug lag khang ni khyad par 'phags pa ste/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i gnas dang mtshungs par bzhengs/ /de yi rgyu mtshan dbang po'i nyer mtsho las/ /gan spos des pa'i dbyibs can ri bo'i khyon/ /dri zhim yid 'phrog mdangs bkra'i chu skyes dang / /rtsi sman gur gum dros pa'i spos ngad ldan/ /sa lu rab tu rgyas pa'i tshal rnams su/ /sna ldan gzhon nu rtse dgas rol ba dang / /'jigs med ri dwags tshogs rnams rgyu ba rnams/ /bung bas brtses pa'i 'khon lan len pa snyam/ /nyung ngu'i gdung ba sel byed dang ba'i chu/ /gser mig spu ring dal gyis rtse ba'i gnas/ /bkod ma'i rdzing bu kha dog mthon mthing yangs/ /sdong ros mdog can pad+mos khyab pa ni/ /dri med mkha' la sgyu skar 'khrigs pa can/ /'dzin ma'i khyon 'di 'khyil zhing 'khyil ba can/ /margad ya lad bgos pa'i ljon shing yang / /yal 'dab phun tshogs grib bsil rab g.yo zhing / /sim byed dri lan dal gyis g.yo ba ni/ /rtse gcig ting 'dzin ldan pa'i dka' thub can/ /drang srong rnams la chags pa'i yid can 'dra/ /bcud ldan 'bras bu mtshar du dngar ba dang / /me tog 'dab ma bzhad cing bzhad pa dag /bstan nam ldan rnams mchod la brtson pa snyam/ /de lta'i dga' tshal yid 'ong nyams dga' ba/ /rin chen sna tshogs brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas khang / /rab mdzes bkod legs gsar du sprul pa'i rten/ /g.yu yi rang bzhin thog phub mtho ba'i rtser/ /'dzam bu'i cod pan du mas spras pa dang / /gser gyi dril g.yer dra ba brel ba yi/ /gser mdog glog phreng rgyu ba'i chu 'dzin ni/ /lha yi lam la dal gyis mdzes pa snyam/ /de mthar thar 'dod thar pa bsgrub pa rnams/ /mnyam rjes mnyam par bzhag pas rten pa'i gnas/ /tshangs pa'i dag byed dge bas dres pa la/ /sna tshogs 'dab ldan 'khrigs pa'i spyil po yang / /brgya phrag du mas khor yug 'khor zhing mchis/ /kun tu gzigs pa'i zhing dang 'dab chags su/

/'bru dang 'bras bzang ldan pa'i nor 'dzin khyon/ /grong dang grong khyer du mas ltar ba la/ /khor yug khor yug chen po ji bzhin du/ /bsra zhing brtan pa'i lcags ri zung gis bskor/ /'ob kyi ra bas rim par bres ba yi/ /bar bar skyed tshal phreng bas mdzes pa'i nang / /ling ling bung ba'i zlos gar bsgyur ba ni/ /'phags pa grong khyer spos ldan ji bzhin no/ /de sogs rgyas par gsungs 'dug thugs gzhis 'tshal/ /de nas 'jam dbyangs sprul pa bsod rtse des/ /grub pa'i gnas der rgyun ring bzhugs par mdzad/ /de nas dgung lo zhe gcig bzhes pa ste/ /chu pho stag gi smal po'i bcu gcig nyin/ /gnas mchog de yi nub byang mtshams nyid na/ /bsgrub chu yod pa'i ltag gi pha bong ni/ /sngo zhing 'khrigs pa thong lcags lta bu'i dbyibs/ /de yi steng du zhabs bzhag brag de la/ /da lta'ang zhib tu bltas na zhabs rjes yod/ /de yi steng nas sku lus ma spangs pa/ /mkha' spyod gshegs pa kun gyis ngo mtshar mthong / /'di la'ang sku lus ma spangs gshegs pa dang / /gdung thal las grub mchod rten yod pa dang / /rje btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan la/ /rtse mo'i gdung gi seb nas sbrang po che'i/ /skad dang 'dra ba'i sgra zhig byung ba sogs/ /bshad tshul shin tu mang ba 'dug na yang / /rje btsun sku mched gdung thal las grub pa/ /zhes pa'i rje btsun sku mched 'di nyid ni/ /rje btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / /de yi gcung po dpal chen 'od po gnyis/ /yin gyi rje btsun rtse mo ma yin no/ /rje btsun chen por gdung gi seb nyid nas/ /sbrang po che yi sgra skad 'dra ba yang / /mnal lam byung gi dngos su ma byung bas/ /des na 'jam dbyangs bsod nams rtse mo de/ /sku lus ma spangs mkha' spyod gshegs pa 'thad/ /'khrul med yin no kun gyis nges par mdzod/ /de ni rje btsun rtse mo'i rnam thar nyid/

/mdor bsdus tsam zhig legs par brjod zin nas/ /da ni mkhyen rab bdag po 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /gsum pa rje btsun chen po grags pa ni/ /sa chen dgung lo nga drug bzhes pa'i tshe/ /me mo yos lo'i smal po zla ba yi/ /tshes ni bco brgyad skar ma rgyal gyi nyin/ /sgo rum gzim spyil dkar po'i gnas mchog tu/ /nyi dros tsam la bkra shis phun tshogs kyi/ /bltas dang bcas te legs par sku bltams gyur/ /cung zhig smra ba mkhyen pa tsam la ni/ /dben par dges shing skam chags med pa dang / /thos bsam bsgom sgrub la sogs gtsor mdzad de/ /byis pa'i spyod pa kun las 'das par gyur/ /de nas dgung lo brgyad nyid bzhes pa'i dus/ /byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan la/ /tshangs par spyod pa'i dge bsnyen sgrub par mdzad/ /de nas btsun pa'i mchog tu gyur pa ste/ /sha chang la sogs cung zad tsam re yang / /gsol bar mi mdzad dang tshul kho na yis/ /dge tshul dge slong dag las lhag pa mdzad/ /bcu gcig pa la sdom pa nyi shu dang / /sgrub thabs mtsho skyes gsungs shing bcu gnyis la/ /bla chen gshegs pa'i chos 'khor mdzad pa'i dus/ /brtag gnyis bshad srol phun tshogs mdzad pa na/ /der yod skye bo thams cad ngo mtshar gyur/ /de nas bzung ste chos grwa chag med gsungs/ /de nas rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo dang / /gtsug tor rgyal po zhang ston tshul khrims grags/ /de la sogs pa'i mkhas grub du ma yi/ /zhabs pad bsten cing mdo sngags mtha' dag gi /gsan pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin mdzad de/ /rig pa'i gnas lnga khongs su chud par mdzad/ /de sogs gsan pa mdzad tshul mtha' yas kyang / /rags pa tsam zhig 'dir ni brjod pa yin/ /gzhan yang dbu rtse rnying ma'i 'khyams smad kyi/ /ka ba nyer bzhi'i sa yul yod pa 'di/ /gtso bo rje btsun chen po'i zhal bkod mdzad/ /rgyu sbyor la sogs bla ma zangs tsha'i yang / /bka' bzhin bsgrub par mdzad pa'i dus kyi tshe/

/sa gzhi de na nag phyogs klu yi tshogs/ /shin tu mang bar 'dug pas de dag rnams/ /gnas pa'i pha bong mang bar yod pa la/ /mon chen rdo rje rā dza zhes bya ba'i/ /rje btsun nyid kyi slob ma nus mthu can/ /de la klu rnams 'khrid ces bka' stsal bas/ /des kyang bka' bzhin bum chus sna drangs te/ /klu rnams gnas pa'i pha bong shas che ba/ /bla brang shar gyi ltag sogs gang 'os dang / /gdug pa che ba'i pha bong gnyis gsum zhig /dbu rtse'i bskor lam lho yi 'og 'khris na/ /yod pa'i pha bong 'di rnams yin pa ste/ /pha bong de rnams so sor bzhag gyur kyang / /nag phyogs klu rnams nus pa che bas na/ /gtsug lag khang la gnod pa byung dogs nas/ /rdo rje rā dzas bum chus sna drangs shing / /klu rnams rim gyis 'khrid pa'i thabs lam dang / /rje btsun chen pos rting nas bskrad par mdzad/ /dpon slob gnyis kas bka' bgros mthun par ni/ /dkar gong lung gi byang gi stod phyogs kyi/ /klu khud zhes bya'i sa de gnang ba mdzad/ /'di la da lta sgra don nor ba ste/ /sle khud zhes bya thams cad gleng bar byed/ /'di ni sle khud ma yin klu khud yin/ /de yi rgyu mtshan klu rnams gnas pa yis/ /sa khud yin phyir de skad brjod pa yin/ /de nas rje btsun chen po de nyid kyis/ /zhal bkod mdzad cing zhu byas dngos grub la/ /sogs pa'i grub chen bcu gsum yod pa yis/ /gtso mdzad skye bo kun gyi sa rdo bskyas/ /grub pa'i rtags dang mtshungs par myur du zin/ /de 'dra'i ngo mtshar chen po'i gtsug lag khang / /legs par grub ste bkra shis mnga' gsol mdzad/ /sgo rum bla ma lha khang rten gtso yi/ /sku 'dra yid bzhin nor bu 'di nyid kyi/ /lo rgyus thung tsam brjod na 'di ltar yin/ /bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa bzhugs pa'i dus/ /gtsang gi nags phug thugs rje dpal bzang yang / /dpon slob thog mnyam tshul du yod pa yin/

/de dus bdag nyid chen po sgo rum gyi/ /bla ma lha khang mda' yi chos khri der/ /bstan bcos sdom gsum rab dbye rtsom par mdzad/ /de la gtsang nag pa sogs phal cher gyis/ /bstan bcos ze ma ra mgo zhes zer zhing / /gzhan yang gtsang nag thugs rje dpal bzang des/ /gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya na/ /bal gyi mtho thong kun gyis bskor ba'i dbus/ /kun dga' rgyal mtshan bag ma'i tshul du bzhugs/ /mkhas pa 'di na yod do gtsang nag pa/ /zhes sogs dus rnams kun tu sku zhus kyi/ /tshig rigs 'dra min sna tshogs mdzad pa de/ /bdag nyid chen po de yis gsan pa dang / /zangs tsha sogs kyi'ang snyan 'debs phul ba la/ /rten nas bstan bcos rtsom pa'i 'phro bshol bar/ /zhal gyis bzhes pas de nub mnal lam du/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa yi/ /sku 'dra 'jam bu chu bo'i gser nyid las/ /legs par grub pa'i yid 'ong ngo mtshar gcig /mi gtsang 'dam gyi khrod du bying ba dang / /'phags mchog klu grub shing sdong skam po la/ /sku rgyab rten cing zhal ngo nag pa dang / /gzhan yang nyi zla gza' yis bzung ba sogs/ /spyan ltas shin tu rtsub pa byung ba'i tshe/ /sang nyin zangs tsha la sogs thams cad la/ /bdag nyid chen po'i bka' stsal 'di bzhin gnang / /nged kyis bstan bcos 'di nyid brtsams pa na/ /mi rnams shin tu mi dga' byed gyur kyang / /ma brtsams na ni dkon mchog thugs khrel 'gyur/ /de yi rgyu mtshan rmi lam 'di ltar byung / /gsungs nas gong gi de rnams zhib par gnang / /der rjes bstan bcos rtsom par mdzad pa na/ /gtsang nag pa de shin tu yid ma rang / /slar yang sku zhus ya ga sgrog pa dang / /khyad par sdom gsum rtsod pa'i yig cha zhig /rtsom par dam bcas lag tu len dgos snyam/ /de yi bsam ngan de nyid skyes ma thag /'jam dbyangs zhal gzigs nub par gyur pa yin/ /de yi rgyu mtshan khong yang sprul pa yi/ /skyes bu yin cing rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyang /

/tho rang dus su rgyun du zhal bstan nas/ /chos kyi sgro 'dogs ma lus gcod par mdzad/ /de 'dra yod kyang rang nyid nga rgyal gyis/ /gzhan rnams kun la gshe bar mdzad pa dang / /khyad par rje btsun chen po 'jam dbyangs nyid/ /mi yi tshul bzung sa skya paṇa chen la/ /dad log skyes pa de yi sdig sgrib la/ /rten nas skad cig tsam yang zhal ma gzigs/ /de nas mkhas pa chen po gtsang nag pa/ /shin tu mnong zhing 'di 'dra cis lan snyam/ /bsam mno yang yang gtong zhing sdug bsngal gyur/ /de yi mod la gzhan la bya thabs med/ /'jam dbyangs nyid la gsol ba btab pa drag /snyam te yus dang bcas pas gsol btab pas/ /tho rangs dus cig sku rgyab bstan nas mthong / /de yang gsal po min pa'i srib be ba/ /de nyid mthong ma thag tu dbugs dngangs shing / /mig chu 'don zhing lha mchog thugs rje chung / /sngar nas rgyun du zhal mthong gsung thos la/ /da thub zhal kyang ma mthong da lan yang / /sku rgyab bstan pa 'di 'dra gang gis lan/ /bdag gi las ngan ci bsags gsungs 'tshal lo/ /de skad zhus shing lus kyis phyag 'tshal dang / /ngag gis smre bshags brjod cing sems nyid kyis/ /'gyod tshangs drag pos bshags pa byas pa na/ /'jam dbyangs nyid kyi zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ /'o na khyod kyi nga yi bstan bcos la/ /rtsod pa'i yig cha rtsom zhing nga la yang / /dus gnas kun tu gshe skur 'debs pa la/ /gzugs mthong ngag nyan dag gi dgos pa ci/ /de ltar gsungs pa'i lan du gtsang nag pas/ /sa paṇa la ni sku zhus phran bu shor/ /de kha ma gtogs 'jam dbyangs khyed nyid la/ /gshe skur cung zad tsam yang byas pa med/ /zhus pas de yi lan du rje btsun gyis/ /nga dang khong gnyis skye ba nyer lnga'i bar/ /dbyer med yin pa khyod kyis ma shes sam/ /tha snyad tshig la sbyang pa che na yang / /nang gi don la ma sbyang 'di 'dra yong / /lha dang bla ma so sor byed pa 'khrul/ /de la sogs pa gnad la skal ba yi/

/lung bstan du ma gnang tshe gtsang nag pas/ /lus kyi ba spu ldang zhing mchi ma 'khrug /ngag nas bdag gis las ngan bsags pa 'di/ /'dag pa'i thabs cig thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ /de skad zhus pas nga yi sku 'dra zhig /legs par bzhengs la rab tu gnas pa de/ /sa paṇa nyid la zhus te deng phyin chad/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig bsrung na legs/ /zhes pa'i bka' gnang bzhin du gtsang nag pas/ /'jam dbyangs longs sku'i cha byad sku 'dra zhig /phal cher bzhengs ste grub la khad pa der/ /yang ni 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal gzigs nas/ /sku 'dra longs sku ma yin sprul sku ste/ /mdor na sa skya paṇa chen khong rang gi /sku yi cha byad ji bzhin dgos rgyu yin/ /de ltar gsungs ma thag tu bka' bzhin bsgrubs/ /legs par grub rjes chos rje sa paṇa la/ /rab tu gnas par gdan 'dren zhu ba dang / /sngar byas 'gyod la bshags pa 'bul ba dang / /phyin chad sdom zhing mi bgyid dam bca' ba/ /gtsang nag mkhas pa de yis sa skyar byon/ /bdag nyid chen po'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dag /mjal ma thag tu 'jam dbyangs dngos su mthong / /de yi mod la cung zad dran med gyur/ /de nas dran pa gsos rjes bshags pa dang / /rab gnas la sogs sngar kyi byung tshul rnams/ /legs par zhus pas bdag nyid chen po des/ /snyan pa'i gsung gis 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /mkhas pa chen po byon pa shin tu legs/ /ngos kyi 'dra 'bag bka' bzhin bsgrubs pa'ang legs/ /de la rab tu gnas pa byed pa la/ /kho bo sku 'dra'i mdun du 'gro mi dgos/ /khyed rang pha gir byon la zhib tshags dang / /smal po zla ba'i yar tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin/ /mchod bshom la sogs gang rgyas 'byor pa dang / /bstun pa'i bkod pa ngo mtshar ldan par mdzod/ /de dang mthun par 'di nas kho bos kyang / /nyi rtse tsam la rab gnas bya 'o gsungs/ /de nas gtsang nag pa yi nags phug tu/ /sku 'dra bzhugs shing mchod bshom la sogs pa/

/bka' lung ji bzhin legs par grub pa na/ /smal zla'i bcu bzhi'i nyi ma shar lhod la/ /nas dkar khyad du 'phags pa khal bcu tsam/ /sku 'dra mchod lcog sogs kyi steng nyid du/ /legs par babs pa kun ni mngon sum mthong / /de 'dra'i ngo mtshar phun tshogs ldan pa yi/ /sku 'dra de ni 'di nyid yin no dgongs/ /'di nyid 'di ru bzhugs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ /bdag nyid chen po de nyid hor yul la/ /ma phebs gong du sku 'dra phyag nas ma/ /chung ngu de 'dra mang po yod na yang / /che ba sku tshad phyag nas bzhugs pa ni/ /'di kha gcig pu ma gtogs med pas na/ /gdan sa bka' bgros pa rnams gros mthun par/ /'di nyid gdan 'dren zhu ba babs thob yin/ /zer ba kha 'chams nags kyi brag phug nas/ /spyan 'dren zhus ste legs par 'di ru phebs/ /brag phug nyid nas spyan 'dren zhus pas na/ /sku 'dra yid bzhin nor bu 'di nyid kyi/ /sku rgyab brag la sbyar ba'i rjes nyid kyang / /da lta'i bar du shin tu gsal bar yod/ /ces dpal ldan sa skya'i gnas bshad rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar snyan brgyud dang bcas pa phun tshogs rgya mtsho'i gter zhes bya ba grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i gsung rtsom gnang 'phro 'thor bur bzhugs pa rnams de nyid kyi slob bu'i tha chung sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyi dus phyis gsung rab 'phro can de rnams mthong ba'i tshe grub mchog dbang po de nyid zhal bzhugs dus kyi sku'i rnam 'gyur dang / gsung dpang mthon po'i sgo nas sa skya'i gnas bshad 'di sngar brtsams lugs 'di ltar yin/ da rtsom lugs 'di ltar byed sogs bka' bkod zhib par nged rang dang chos rgyal chen po nam mkha' tshe dbang sogs dad 'dus mang po la sgo rum mgon khang mdor sgam nag gi nang mjal gnang dus bka' stsal lhug par phebs pa rnams dran pa'i rkyen byas nas dad pa rtse gcig pa'i yid kyis phyogs gcig tu stag lo zla ba dgu pa'i dmar cha rdzogs pa gsum pa'i tshes la sprul pa'i lha khang chen mo'i shar lho rigs 'dzin pho brang du bsgrigs pa 'dis 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo'i dgongs pa chos dbyings su rdzogs par gyur cig

/'dir smras pa/ 'di bgyis dge bas bdag gzhan thams cad kyi/ /thog med dus nas da lta'i bar nyid du/ /lus ngag yid kyi mi dge ci bsags pa/ /nongs gyur de dag ma lus kun byang nas/ /grub mchog ded dpon 'jam dpal dbang po dang / /pad 'byung dbyer med thugs kyi ye shes nyid/ /bdag sems gdod ma'i gnas lugs ro gcig pa'i/ /rten 'brel zab mo gang de'i byin rlabs kyis/ /dus 'dir bdag cag dpon slob gdul byar bcas/ /bar chad g.yul rnams kun las rnam rgyal nas/ /tshe ring nad med gzugs bzang don 'grub ste/ /bstan pa mchog tu 'phel pa'i mthu ldan zhing / /dri med brgyud pa'i yun du skyong ba dang / /nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ma thag /dpon slob thams cad 'bral med lhan cig pas/ /zhing mchog bde ba can du skye bar shog /de skad smra ba gti mug dgra las rgyal phyir 'khon/ /ngo mtshar phun tshogs dge legs yon tan bskyed phyir sa/ /sdug bsngal rtsa ba sdig pa'i dri ma spangs phyir skya/ /rigs dang gnas kyi mtshan nyid de ldan gang de 'o/ /zhes pa 'di'i yi ge pa ni rab 'byams smra ba rgya mtsho'i mtha' can no// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ dpal sa skya'i gnas bshad rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar snyan brgyud dang bcas pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
